jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Hope Mission Statement**

The mission of Hope the Mission is to prevent, reduce and eliminate poverty, hunger, and homelessness by offering immediate assistance and long-term solutions.

**Position Purpose and Summary**

Interim housing programs run on direct service and leadership. What keeps them running — accurately, compliantly, and without things falling through the cracks — is coordination. The Program Coordinator is responsible for that infrastructure.

Reporting to the Program Manager or Assistant Program Manager, the Program Coordinator provides the administrative, operational, and data coordination support that enables assigned HTM interim housing sites to function in alignment with agency policies, funder requirements, and contract standards. This role tracks documentation, monitors compliance tasks, maintains participant records in HMIS, reviews shift reports, follows up on incidents, and ensures that the operational details of daily program life are organized, accounted for, and ready for scrutiny. When audits happen, when monitoring visits arrive, when leadership needs to know whether documentation is current — the Program Coordinator is the reason the answer is yes.

This is not a supervisory role, and the distinction is deliberate. The Program Coordinator's value is in coordination, quality control, and follow-through — not authority. It requires someone who can hold a high volume of moving parts with precision and calm, who understands that a missing daily activity report or an untracked incident is not a paperwork problem but a compliance risk, and who takes both the operational and the relational dimensions of the work seriously. Programs do not run on good intentions. They run on systems, and this role is responsible for keeping those systems intact.

**Primary Duties and Responsibilities**

*Data, Documentation & Compliance*

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date participant records in HMIS and other agency-approved data systems
* Track completion of required program documents including Daily Activity Reports (DARs), wellness check logs, incident report submissions, and case management documentation
* Conduct first-level review of documentation for completeness and accuracy; flag missing or late items for follow-up
* Submit and follow up on all incident reports in accordance with agency protocols
* Review shift reports regularly to monitor staff performance and documentation compliance
* Maintain organized participant files, rosters, logs, and trackers in accordance with program and funder requirements
* Assist with preparation for audits, monitoring visits, and internal reviews by gathering and organizing requested documentation
* Support program and contract compliance by regularly reviewing logs, records, and data against funder requirements

*Operations & Site Management*

* Monitor the medication cabinet and review all medication records
* Track supply inventory and submit facility maintenance, IT, and supply order requests with Program Manager approval
* Regularly inspect bathroom facilities, shelter rooms, and site surroundings to ensure clean, sanitary, and safe conditions
* Report maintenance issues and repair needs to the supervisor promptly
* Help train janitorial and hygiene staff on proper site and bathroom maintenance protocols
* Coordinate communication between shifts, departments, and program leadership regarding operational needs and follow-up items
* Provide on-site support during high-volume or high-need operational periods
* Work collaboratively with outsourced security staff to maintain safety for participants, staff, volunteers, and visitors
* Train staff on the use of security and surveillance systems

*Staff Support & Coordination*

* Provide direction and training to shelter support staff including Client Service Monitors and Case Managers in collaboration with the Program Manager or Assistant Program Manager
* Maintain staff timesheets and daily activity reports as directed
* Support onboarding processes by coordinating training schedules, tracking credentials, and organizing required documentation
* Schedule meetings, case conferences, and staff training sessions as directed
* Provide staff coverage as needed, including substituting as a Client Service Monitor during absences
* Provide feedback to leadership on service delivery, program enhancements, and operational modifications as needed

*Participant & Community Engagement*

* Assist with participant issues including conflict resolution and complaint resolution using de-escalation and mediation techniques
* Provide emergency service referrals and warm handoffs for domestic violence, human trafficking, sexual assault, and other crisis needs as appropriate
* Ensure implementation of Housing First, Harm Reduction, and Trauma-Informed Care principles across all participant interactions
* Support participant engagement activities, orientations, and program communications as assigned
* Support case management services to participants as needed
* Build and maintain positive working relationships with community partners including mental health programs, law enforcement, neighborhood councils, and service providers

*General*

* Assist leadership with special projects, reports, and data pulls as needed
* Attend staff meetings, case conferences, training workshops, and community meetings as required
* Coordinate external partners, service providers, and volunteers as directed
* Adhere to all organizational policies related to attendance, dress code, professionalism, and conduct
* Identify and report unsafe situations, systems, or processes to supervisors promptly
* Perform other duties as assigned

**Requirements**

* Must pass pre-employment and ongoing drug and alcohol screenings
* Must pass background check as required per worksite
* Must provide proof of legal authorization to work in the United States
* Must comply with all HTM policies including safety, confidentiality, conduct, and HIPAA sta

jobs.title: Program Coordinator (Part-Time) - Housing
jobs.description:
**DEFINITION**
--------------

***Come work for the beautiful City of Redondo Beach located in Los Angeles County in the South Bay region known for its scenic beaches, relaxed seaside atmosphere, and vibrant waterfront as part of our Housing Authority Division of the Community Services Department.***

  

The Redondo Beach Housing Authority administers the Housing Choice Voucher rental assistance program. It also manages specialized programs such as Veterans Affairs Supportive Housing (VASH), Emergency Housing Vouchers (EHV), Project-Based Vouchers, and Foster Youth for Independence (FYI) programs that are funded by the Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD), which is a branch of the federal government.

  
Under direction of a supervisor, this position is responsible for performing paraprofessional duties and supporting the Housing Division staff with general clerical tasks. The position serves as the first contact for the Housing Division providing outstanding customer service to program participants and the public. Responsibilities also include addressing general inquiries regarding the Housing programs administered by the Housing Division.
  
  
This is a part-time, at-will position that is not eligible for City benefits. Only those applicants in which the hiring department is interested will receive further contact after application submission. Prompt application is encouraged.

**EXAMPLES OF DUTIES, RESPONSIBILITIES AND EXPECTATIONS**
---------------------------------------------------------

**Duties include, but are not limited to:**

* Reviews client applications for eligibility of rental assistance
* Monitors and supervises program participants
* Resolves concerns between tenant, landlord, and the Housing Authority
* Confers and collaborates with other social services providers as appropriate
* Collects and reports participant data to HUD
* Operates a motor vehicle in the performance of home inspections
* Conduct HUD NSPIRE inspections
* Performs other related duties as assigned

  
Perform various routine administrative duties, including data entry and operating standard office equipment such as a personal computer. Effective use of software such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook. Work in a professional office environment greeting patrons, answering telephones, filing, copying, scanning, proofreading documents, and other duties as assigned.  
  
  

Sample duties include, but are not limited to:

Perform daily administrative and clerical duties, including scheduling, data entry, record-keeping, correspondence, and conducts on-site HUD NSPIRE inspections of residential units for the Housing Division.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**
--------------------------

Knowledge of: Materials, equipment, regulations, principles, procedures and practices related to youth and senior activities, recreational programs, group activities, games and sports; applicable health and safety regulations; first aid; record keeping practices and procedures; modern office practices, procedures and equipment; report writing; basic mathematical computations; applicable sections of the California Vehicle Code.
  
  
Ability to: Meet medical and physical employment standards for the classification; read, write, speak and understand English; understand and follow oral and written directions; compose correspondence, brochures, flyers and other informational documents; provide information to the public in person, by telephone, or through written correspondence where judgment, knowledge and interpretive skills may be required; communicate effectively orally and in writing; work overtime as necessary; establish and maintain effective working relationships with co-workers and members of the public; legally operate a motor vehicle in the State of California.
  
  
Education and Experience: Effective leadership skills, creativity, good decision making and exercising appropriate judgment, the ability to teach, and the ability to lead by example are preferred qualities. Must be at least 18 years of age to apply. Must possess a valid California Driver's License. Completion of high school is required, and some college course work a related field is highly desired.

**SUPPLEMENTAL INFORMATION**
----------------------------

**SELECTION PROCESS:**

The selection process may include but is not limited to: Application review and evaluation, written examination, performance test and interview. All employment offers made by the City are contingent upon establishing proof of a prospective candidate's legal authorization to work in the United States and successfully passing all components of the pre-employment process. The pre-employment process may include but not be limited to: Reference checks, background investigation, fingerprint-based criminal history check, credit check, degree verification, and post-offer medical examination and drug test. For public safety positions, including positions based in the Police and/or Fire Department(s), the pre-employment process may also include but not be limited to a P.O.S.T. compliant background check, polygraph examination, post-offer medical examination and drug test, and post-offer psychological examination.

Candidates must fill out the employment application and supplemental questions completely and accurately. Required fields and supplemental questions are noted with an asterisk (\*). All other fields are optional. Applications including references to "see resume" are considered incomplete and will be disqualified.

The City of Redondo Beach is an Equal Opportunity Employer. The City will provide reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities and encourages both prospective and current employees to discuss potential accommodations with the employer. Candidates with a disability who may need accommodation during the selection process must notify the Human Resources Department at least five (5) business days in advance of the test date.

jobs.title: Graduate Program Coordinator, Mathematics, Philosophy, and Physics
jobs.description:

* Partner with the crewing team to source and hire control rooms, stage, and remote crews.
* Research and book locations, manage permitting, and process related paperwork, including vendor documents, releases, certificates of insurance, and payments.
* Partner with the Travel team to book flights, hotels, and rental vehicles.
* Ensure crew onboarding is complete before filming and support crews on location.
* Support the Production Manager in coordinating studio staff, facilities, and daily operations.
* Supervise, schedule, and support our team of Production Assistants.

* Help train new Production Assistants on department processes and procedures.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Who are Coolr?**

We’re an independent social media agency and team of creatives, social experts, content publishers and change makers. Completely wired into popular culture, our work connects brands with their audiences at scale. With clients such as Burger King, Lidl, Harvest Snaps and Skyscanner (to name drop a few) our aim is to be the biggest social agency in the world.

The agency is growing at a rapid rate, but we’re only just getting started. In 2026, we have ambitious plans to truly become the stand-out social agency in the UK, the US, and beyond. We have a strong platform for growth and have made great strides forward – now we really want to take things to the next level.

**About the role:**

We're looking for an Account Manager to join our team. You'll sit between the Senior Account Director and the Social executive below you. Owning the day-to-day running of your accounts, keeping campaigns on track and making sure the team has what they need to deliver.

This is a role for someone organized, culturally switched on and genuinely passionate about social media. You'll be hands-on across client communications, creative, production and influencer work streams.

**The job:**

**Client Services**

* Serve as the main day-to-day contact for clients, building strong working relationships under the guidance of the Account Director
* Lead scheduled and ad hoc client calls and deliver presentations with a passion for storytelling
* Keep status documents updated daily and ensure the wider team is informed of actions and priorities
* Manage campaigns end-to-end - timelines, budgets, client expectations and internal resource
* Support the Account Director on budget development and reconciliation at project close
* Support executives with weekly, monthly and quarterly reportingCreative, Strategy & Production
* Stay immersed in social culture and proactively flag reactive opportunities across your accounts
* Receive and translate client briefs, breaking these down for internal teams and reviewing work before client delivery
* Contribute to internal creative brainstorm sessions, supporting the Senior Account Director in pushing creative thinking
* Manage the full production process - from pre-production and PPMs through to shoots and edit schedules
* Manage the editorial process, briefing the team on content calendar creation and providing feedback throughout
* Review reactive social opportunities and provide appropriate creative feedback

**Influencer**

* Support the influencer team with talent management and fee negotiation
* Approve influencers and influencer content from a client and brand perspective, considering reputation, fit and objectives
* Review contracts and briefs for all influencer activity across your accounts

**Internal & Management**

* First line of support for executives - 1:1s, day-to-day guidance, workload management and mentorship
* Lead internal status calls and act as the main point of contact for internal queries on your accounts
* Manage invoicing across campaigns, including raising POs and scheduling payments with the accounts team

**What we are looking for**

*Whilst we appreciate, you’re not just your CV and skills are transferable, these are some of the skills and experiences we think would set you up for success in this role:*

* Proven experience in an account management role within a social or creative agency
* Strong client-facing skills - confident presenting, leading calls and building relationships
* Excellent project management ability - detail-oriented, deadline-driven and able to juggle multiple accounts
* Comfortable managing budgets and tracking delivery against scope
* Deeply plugged into social culture, trends and platforms
* A natural collaborator who can brief, manage and support internal teams
* Experience managing or mentoring junior team member

**A Coolr Offer**

*We appreciate all the hard work that our teams deliver every day — here are some of the benefits and perks you’ll enjoy while working at Coolr:*

Competitive salary reflective of your experience and aligned with our internal salary bands.

‍️Flexible Hybrid working. We work 3 days in the office and 2 from home

Enjoy 20 days of paid time off (PTO), in addition to all U.S. Federal Holidays.

Birthday Day off – an extra day to celebrate your big day

Wellbeing day off — one additional day off plus a $50 voucher to support your wellbeing.

Private Healthcare cover, Tech scheme + more

Coolr weekly socials - we get together every week to connect as a team

A competitive, benchmarked salary ranging from $85,000-100k, based on your experience and level.

**Coolr Culture:**

We are one team. Regardless of what you work on at the agency, we will help and support each other on everything. The goal is to turn our clients into rockstars by creating ground-breaking, award-winning and impactful campaigns for them. The team culture is to push out of our comfort zones to strive for excellence whilst allowing everyone to embrace their true selves and tap into their potential.

**Coolr DE&I**

Our approach to DE&I at Coolr is simple: create a safe and inclusive environment for people to be authentically themselves. By embracing this culture, it gives space to people to be more creative, innovative, and successful which will drive us in our mission of becoming the world’s best social media agency. Whilst we are proud of our current position and the work we do to support a thriving and diverse workplace, we always know we can do more to not only create change here at Coolr, but in our industry as a whole.

jobs.title: Control Account Manager (Associate or Mid-Level)
jobs.description:
At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

The Boeing Test & Evaluation (BT&E) organization is seeking a **Control Account Manager (Associate or Mid-Level)** to join our team in **Long Beach, CA**.

BT&E provides enterprise test capabilities supporting multiple Boeing commercial, defense, and government programs. This position will support Southern California Aeronautical System Integration & Test (ASIT) laboratories, including System Integration Laboratories (SIL), Hardware-in-the-Loop Simulators (HILS), and Flight Management System (FMS) Lab capabilities.

The selected candidate will serve as a key member of the BT&E leadership team, responsible for planning, executing, and monitoring control accounts that enable critical laboratory operations, modernization efforts, technology investments, and customer-funded development activities. This role works closely with engineering leaders, Integrated Product Teams (IPTs), program customers, finance, planning, and functional leadership to ensure successful execution of scope, schedule, and cost commitments.

We are seeking candidates who are highly collaborative, analytical, and proactive leaders with a passion for driving execution excellence across complex technical environments.

**Position Responsibilities:**

* Serves as Control Account Manager (CAM) for assigned BT&E laboratory and capability development scope.
* Leads Earned Value Management (EVM) execution, including baseline planning, work authorization, forecasting, variance analysis, and corrective action development.
* Partners with engineering and laboratory leaders to develop executable plans supporting laboratory operations, sustainment, and modernization initiatives.
* Monitors cost, schedule, and technical performance against approved baselines and develops recovery plans when necessary.
* Coordinates cross-functional execution activities across engineering, finance, planning, procurement, facilities, information technology, and operations teams.
* Supports development of Basis of Estimates (BOEs), Rough Order Magnitude (ROM) estimates, and proposal activities for internal and external customers.
* Develops program metrics, performance reporting, and executive-level briefings to support leadership decision-making.
* Performs Estimate-at-Complete (EAC) and Estimate-to-Complete (ETC) assessments and supports monthly business rhythm activities.
* Identifies risks and opportunities associated with laboratory infrastructure, test capability development, resource planning, and customer commitments.
* Supports Integrated Baseline Reviews (IBRs), audits, customer reviews, and compliance activities.
* Leads process improvement initiatives focused on affordability, operational efficiency, and business performance.
  

  

**Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):**

* Bachelor's degree or higher
* 3+ years of experience performing in a finance, scheduling, industrial engineering, change management, strategy, business support services, program management, project management or business operations role
* Experience managing cost and schedule performance using Earned-Value Management (EVM) principles
* Experience utilizing Microsoft Office applications such as SharePoint, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Microsoft Project

**Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):**

* Previous experience serving as a Control Account Manager (CAM)
* Experience with Earned Value Management System (EVMS) processes and DFARS requirements
* Experience supporting System Integration Labs (SIL), Hardware-in-the-Loop Simulators (HILS), test environments, or engineering laboratories
* Experience developing Basis of Estimates (BOEs) and supporting proposal activities
* Experience performing Estimate-at-Complete (EAC) forecasting and variance analysis
* Experience with Cobra, Open Plan, Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, or related program management tools
* Experience supporting multiple customers across Commercial Airplanes, Boeing Global Services, Defense, Space & Security, or Government Services organizations
* Experience leading business transformation, operational excellence, or capability modernization initiatives
* Experience presenting to senior leadership and customer stakeholders
* Active U.S. Secret Security Clearance

**Conflict of Interest:**

Successful candidate for this job must satisfy the Company’s Conflict of Interest (COI) assessment process.

**Drug Free Workplace:**  
Boeing is a Drug Free Workplace where post offer applicants and employees are subject to testing for marijuana, cocaine, opioids, amphetamines, PCP, and alcohol when criteria is met as outlined in our policies.

  
  

**Pay & Benefits:**
  
At Boeing, we strive to deliver a Total Rewards package that will attract, engage, and retain the top talent. Elements of the Total Rewards package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities.

  

The Boeing Company also provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work.

The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

  
  

Pay is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

  
  

**Summary pay range:**

**Level 2:** $81,600-$110,400

**Level 3:** $101,150-$136,850

  
  

Applications for this position will be accepted until **Dec. 08, 2026**

**ABOUT US**

Fashion Nova is the world's leading trend-to-market fashion and lifestyle brand with high-growth categories across its Women, Men, Kids and Beauty divisions. Renowned for delivering the most-wanted styles to millions worldwide, Fashion Nova earned the title of the Top 5 Most-Searched Fashion Brand on Google in 2022, alongside Louis Vuitton and Nike.

Founder & CEO Richard Saghian launched the brand in 2006, from a retail location in Los Angeles. After multiple store openings, Saghian launched the e-commerce website for Fashion Nova in 2013, pioneering a disruptive social commerce model of affordable, on-trend, size-inclusive clothing online – powered by an innovative, social media-first marketing strategy.

Today, Fashion Nova has amassed over 40 million social media followers, with annual sales of approximately $2 billion!

The brand's name has been featured in chart-topping hit songs by Cardi B, Drake, 21 Savage, Saweetie, The Game, Tyga and Offset and its styles have been worn by many celebrities, artists and athletes including Meg The Stallion, Ice Spice, Chris Brown, Floyd Mayweather, Rick Ross, Kourtney Kardashian, and Kylie Jenner.

Bachelor's degree or above, or equivalent experience

1–3+ years of experience in TikTok livestream or live selling; hands-on familiarity with TikTok Live Studio, TikTok Seller Center, and OBS

LA Vintage is a family-owned wholesale vintage company in Los Angeles. We sort millions of pounds of clothing, shoes, and accessories every year, and since 2008 we've supplied retail shops, designers, wholesalers, and stylists around the world straight from our own warehouse.

* Follow up with past clients to drive reorders

**How Success Is Measured**

* Order accuracy: orders ship complete, correct, and on time

**What You Bring**

* Builds routines and sticks to them
* Comfortable with numbers, spreadsheets, and tracking results
* Detail-oriented: you catch mistakes before clients do

- Find and develop new business in your assigned territory

- Deliver and follow up on sample requests promptly  
- Attend industry events, trade shows, and networking functions  
- Keep accurate, up-to-date records in HubSpot CRM  
- Work with the Sales Manager and operations team to make project delivery seamless  
- Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly revenue targets

- 2 to 5 years of sales experience, ideally in architecture, interior design, construction, or luxury materials  
- Existing relationships in the design and build community (a strong plus)  
- Specification or consultative selling experience (preferred)  
- Familiarity with construction, building materials, or decorative finishes  
- CRM experience, HubSpot preferred  
- Ability to read architectural drawings and design specifications  
- Confident presenting to senior designers, architects, and project stakeholders  
- Strong organization across many projects and follow-ups at once  
- Self-motivated and comfortable working independently  
- Patient with long sales cycles and relationship-based selling  
- A genuine passion for design, interiors, and premium finishes, and a polished, professional presence

What we offer:  
- Competitive base salary plus commission  
- Territory ownership: build your own book of business  
- Room to grow with a fast-scaling premium brand

- Support from an experienced Sales Manager and operations team

*Construction Knowledge & Cost Management*

*Project Coordination & Oversight*

The Office of Campus Organizations & Volunteer Programs (COVP) is a unit under Student Life & Leadership at UC Irvine. COVP supports nearly 700 student organizations and leads campus-wide volunteer and community engagement efforts. While students are our primary audience, we also work collaboratively with a diverse community of campus partners, including faculty, staff, and community members who serve as advisors or are involved in campus organizations. Our office works with a wide range of constituents, from students who are already engaged to those seeking new ways to get involved, as well as faculty and staff who participate in or advise campus organizations. COVP empowers students to develop leadership skills, build community, and make a positive impact through advising, resources, signature programs, and service opportunities. The Program Coordinator also plays a key role in supporting advisors of RCOs, helping to foster an inclusive and vibrant campus environment where all members can connect, grow, and contribute.

In addition, the Program Coordinator works closely with the Assistant Director to support volunteer and community service programs, helping to organize service projects and encourage student involvement in meaningful community engagement. The position collaborates with the Director on program coordination, assessment, and ongoing improvement, and supervises and mentors Campus Organizations Activities Coordinators and student interns. The Program Coordinator also manages departmental marketing and social media, ensuring communications are clear, engaging, and reach the right audiences. Collaboration is a key part of this role, as the Program Coordinator regularly works with a diverse community of students, advisors, faculty, staff, and campus partners.  
  
  
  
Overall, this position is focused on building community, supporting student leaders, and helping COVP remain flexible and responsive to campus needs as programs and resources evolve.

**Ecology Center Background:**

The Ecology Center's mission is to inspire and build a sustainable, healthy, and just future for the East Bay, California, and beyond. Since 1970, we've transformed sustainability ideas into everyday practice, offering actionable information, reliable infrastructure, and leadership for lasting change. We operate the nation's first curbside recycling service, nationally recognized food and farming programs, and model education, engagement, and youth development activities.

**Role Overview:**

The Farmers' Market Access and Equity Program Coordinator works under the direction of the Farmers' Market AccessEquity Program Manager, in coordination with the Food and Farming Program Director, to assist with all aspects relating to the Ecology Center's work promoting healthy food access at California farmers' markets. The Farmers' Markets Access and Equity Program Coordinator works to establish, implement, promote, and incentivize Federal Assistance Benefit use at farmers' markets and other direct marketing outlets to create greater healthy food choices for low-income and underserved populations and drive additional customers/income to small and mid-sized family farmers.

The Ecology Center is actively working to create and promote an alternative food system that is based on the values of environmental protection, justice, and access to healthy, sustainably produced food for all. The Farmers' Markets AccessEquity Program (FMAE) seeks to create greater healthy food choices for low-income and underserved Californians while also supporting small and mid-sized family farms. The FMAE Program Coordinator works to establish, implement, promote, and incentivize SNAP benefit use at farmers' markets and other direct marketing outlets. The FMAE Program Coordinator performs job duties in support of the Ecology Center's work supporting healthy food access at California farmers' markets, including the Market Match Program, Farmers' Market EBT/SNAP access programming , and the FMFinder.org tool. This is a hybrid position that requires employees to work onsite at least 2 days per week. The position is covered under the Ecology Center/IWW Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA), and employees are required to maintain union membership once they complete their probation period.

* Assist with facilitating bi-monthly webinars, phone calls, the annual Market Match conference, and other meetings.
* Educate, recruit, and inform farmers' market managers, associations, and partner organizations interested in CalFresh EBT access at farmers' markets and Market Match incentives, through the development and distribution of Program communications, including informational materials and e-newsletters.
* Periodically coordinate regional outreach campaign logistics including direct mailers, text message, and other forms of outreach, aimed at recruiting new customers to farmers' markets.
* Perform site-visits with Market Match partners throughout the state to ensure program and grant compliance.
* Input and maintain data in order to feed statewide databases, fundraise, and report for grants.
* Customize promotional, outreach, and educational collateral.

An AI-first healthcare staffing CRM supports your work with AI-assisted sourcing, candidate matching, recruiting automation, and analytics. These tools enhance—not replace—your judgment, creativity, and ability to build trust. You’ll learn to combine technology with personalized communication while working toward clear activity and performance goals.
  
  
You’ll collaborate with experienced healthcare recruiters, account executives, recruiting leaders, and marketing professionals as you develop transferable skills in sales, business development, talent acquisition, and account management. As you demonstrate results and deepen your understanding of healthcare markets, you’ll have opportunities to take on greater responsibility and build a long-term career.
  
  
The ideal candidate is ambitious, resilient, organized, and comfortable connecting with new people by phone and through digital channels. Strong communication, consistent follow-through, curiosity, and a goal-oriented mindset are essential. You should be motivated by measurable results, receptive to feedback, and eager to learn how AI and recruiting technology can improve sourcing and engagement.
  
  
Prior healthcare recruiting experience is not required. Experience in sales, customer success, staffing, marketing, hospitality, healthcare, or another relationship-focused field can provide a strong foundation. Familiarity with nursing or hospital environments is helpful, but drive, adaptability, and a willingness to learn matter. This is an outbound sales and recruiting position designed for someone pursuing a long-term sales career—not an administrative HR role or a patient-care assignment.
  
  
Based in downtown San Francisco, you’ll build your career in a city known for technology, entrepreneurship, and innovation. The location offers access to a broad professional network, public transportation, diverse neighborhoods, dining, and cultural attractions, with Northern California’s outdoor destinations within reach.
  
  
Clinical Management Consultants offers competitive base compensation, uncapped commissions, bonus opportunities, and a comprehensive benefits package that includes health coverage and a 401(k) retirement plan. If you’re ready to bring ambition, curiosity, and competitive drive to healthcare sales and recruiting, contact the Clinical Management Consultants recruiting team to learn more about this Entry-Level Sales Development Representative opportunity.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
**Overview**

**About MAI**  
Microsoft AI (MAI) is on a mission to create AI that empowers people, organizations, and society. We build the models, systems, and experiences that power some of Microsoft's most ambitious AI innovations, leveraging cutting-edge research, world-class engineering, and large-scale infrastructure to advance the state of the art. Our teams work across foundation models, reasoning systems, agents, AI infrastructure, and product experiences, bringing breakthrough AI capabilities to millions of users around the world.
  
  
MAI is a startup-like team inside Microsoft, created to push the boundaries of AI toward Humanist Superintelligence — ultra-capable systems that remain controllable, safety-aligned, and anchored to human values. Our mission is to create AI that amplifies human potential while ensuring humanity remains firmly in control. We aim to deliver breakthroughs that benefit society — advancing science, education, and global well-being.
  
  
Our team is led by Mustafa Suleyman, CEO of Microsoft AI. We bring together leading researchers, engineers, and product builders who have contributed to many of the most significant advances in modern AI.
  
  
**About the Role**  
We're looking for a Social Media Manager to plan, write and publish content for Microsoft AI's social channels and support key leadership accounts. You'll explain our models, research and products, share our ideas about AI and its role in society, and manage day-to-day community engagement. You'll listen to feedback, track how content performs and test new ideas based on what you learn.  
  
This is a hands-on individual-contributor role, working with product leadership, the Creative Studio and product marketing teams across Microsoft. We're looking for someone who can run channels independently, write in distinct voices and judge which conversations and formats are relevant to our audiences.

 **Responsibilities**

**Responsibilities**

* Own the content calendar and publishing process, including reviews and leadership approvals. Recommend which accounts, platforms and formats to use and how to sequence posts, with a clear rationale.
* Follow developments in AI, culture and social platforms. Propose timely content and new formats, with judgement about when to join a conversation.
* Write and edit posts, threads and short video scripts, including launch announcements, research explainers and ongoing content showing how people use our models. Work with creative and editorial colleagues on platform-specific ideas and assets, and check claims before publication.
* Work with product leadership on narrative and messaging for launches and executive content. Develop posts for key leadership accounts that reflect each leader's perspective and voice.
* Coordinate launch posts and reposts with Microsoft social and developer relations teams, and with colleagues managing external partners. Follow agreed embargoes and release timings.
* Manage our social communities: respond to questions within agreed guidance, encourage discussion and follow up. Flag sensitive issues for leadership review.
* Monitor mentions, sentiment and recurring questions. Share audience feedback with product leadership and marketing teams, flag emerging concerns and identify topics we should address.
* Agree channel goals and track results. Test content, formats and publishing times, then use performance data and community feedback to adjust the plan. Report on performance and the changes you make.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required/Minimum Qualifications**

* Experience independently managing an organisation’s social accounts, including planning, writing and publishing content in its brand voice, and managing community engagement.
* Strong writing and editing skills, with work samples showing different audiences and voices and making your contribution clear.
* Sound judgement about tone, timing and cultural relevance, including handling confidential information and sensitive conversations.
* Experience using publishing, listening and analytics tools, with examples of how you used feedback and results to improve content.
* Experience working with product leadership, marketing and creative teams on content and reviews.

**Additional or Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience writing for executive or public-figure accounts in their individual voices.
* Experience creating content for technology, research or developer audiences, with curiosity about AI and the ability to make complex subjects accessible.
* Experience producing short-form video or working closely with video and design teams.
* Experience supporting launches and live events.

There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $160,200 - $261,000 per year.

jobs.description:
**Organization Overview**

Family & Child Empowerment Services (FACES) provides families who live and work in San Francisco with high-quality early childhood education and enrichment; job support, training, and placement; and comprehensive family support services and referrals. Our mission is to empower families who live and work in San Francisco to transform their futures through evidence-based educational and economic opportunities.

**Position Summary**

As the Operations Coordinator, you are an integrity driven person at the center of the day-to-day operations and activities at the Bayview Child Development Center. This is a great opportunity for someone who is organized, detail-oriented and enjoys delivering great customer service in an educational setting. You have a passion for developing efficient systems to support operations and take pride in maintaining a welcoming, organized and safe environment. You are able to find harmony while holding multiple responsibilities and are thorough with everything you accomplish. You are empathetic and deeply committed to equitable service for all the children, families and staff.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Provide general administrative support with a preference to support the opening shift at the school, receiving and greeting all visitors, taking on complex copying jobs, front desk reception, and routing center mail and deliveries.
* Communicate with school staff, outside agencies, and parents and families to share information, request and provide materials, resolve issues or concerns (via Learning Genie) or other forms of communication.
* Establish and maintain confidential files/records, including student enrollment, attendance, and contact data.
* Complete data entry required for government grant compliance (student attendance, DPH immunization reporting, meal counts).
* With the Site Supervisor’s, schedule and maintain relationships with substitute teacher vendor agencies and manage scheduling and canceling of subs.
* Coordinate and maintain a schedule, with the Site Supervisor’s, for appropriate classroom coverage including managing breaks and transition times.
* Along the Site Supervisor’s, support center safety including leading emergency response drills and monitoring emergency supply inventory.
* Schedule, coordinate, and monitor contractors and vendors for repairs and ongoing maintenance in partnership with the Director of Operations and Facilities.
* Maintain the overall appearance and functionality of the school environment, including decorating for events, keeping bulletin boards updated, and general upkeep of shared spaces such as entrances and the staff lounge, while consistently prioritizing safety.
* Assist with planning, advertising, and hosting student and family events.
* Assist with school-wide communication, including newsletters, flyers, and brochures.
* Manage centralized inventory of supplies and materials and order center supplies as needed.
* In partnership with the enrollment department, assist with new family orientations and enrollment process including scheduling intakes, participating in educating families on center-based systems.
* Work closely with our partners to maintain compliance and complete monthly reports.
* Identify gaps in operations work and develop systems to support efficiency and sustainability

**Minimum Qualifications**:

*You have a solid mix of the following knowledge, ability, skills and experience:*

* 2-3 years of experience working in a bustling, high energy and dynamic collaborative office environment (school-based environment a plus).
* Completion of at least 12 ECE/CD units ("core"courses such as child growth/development, child/family/community, and curriculum)
* Bilingual (Spanish/English) preferred
* Ability to exercise good judgment and discretion in handling confidential materials and matters.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to details; ability to work accurately, independently and manage multiple projects effectively.
* Ability to frequently lift a range of weight from ten (10) to forty (40) pounds
* Ability to relate and communicate to individuals from diverse ethnic, cultural and socioeconomic backgrounds and to work with them in a fair, supportive and cooperative manner.
* Proficient in computer navigation, communication, MS Office and client database systems
* Ability to meet and maintain required state, federal, local, and CDC standards (including but not limited to fingerprint clearance, negative TB test, First Aid, CPR)
* A deep commitment to aligning all program practices to FACES values, especially around equity, inclusion, and belonging for all our stakeholder
* Strong passion for and a desire to humbly reflect and grow in pursuit of our mission
* Completion of 6-12 ECE units to assist with ratio in the morning or breaks if needed
* A sense of humor- we believe joy and justice go hand in hand!

**What We Offer**

* Hourly rate range is $36.00-$40.00 based on experience
* Healthcare premiums 100% paid for employees and 25% paid for dependents
* Three weeks of vacation, personal and floating holidays, twelve sick days, ten paid holidays (including one-week winter closure between Christmas and New Year’s) and a day off for your birthday!
* A retirement plan with employer match up to 7% of your salary
* A chance to positively impact the lives of young children and their families
* A fun, dynamic and collaborative working environment
* Opportunity to join a movement to achieve educational, economic, and racial justice!

**FACES is a welcoming space for all. We embrace diversity in all forms- race, gender identity, sexuality, country of origin, religion, or ability. Candidates with diverse backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply. FACES is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.**

jobs.description:
INVNT is a global experiential marketing and brand storytelling agency that specializes in live events, digital experiences, and integrated campaigns that drive audience engagement and brand growth. Our team of creative strategists, producers, and innovators helps Fortune 500 companies, cultural icons, and purpose-driven organizations bring their brand stories to life. From immersive brand activations and product launches to virtual summits and content-rich campaigns, we create meaningful experiences that resonate across every channel.

With a proven track record in innovation, strategy, and execution, INVNT blends creativity with results to help brands break through noise, connect with audiences, and leave lasting impressions worldwide.

We’re looking for an administrative rock star who thrives on details, loves building order out of complexity, and has the instincts to anticipate what a team needs before they even ask.

This person will be the engine behind the team—owning the processes, systems, logistics, and day-to-day coordination that keep the team moving and working across project teams. You’ll work across people, projects, events, and operations, making sure nothing falls through the cracks, and everyone has what they need to do their best work.

This is a role for someone who doesn’t just manage a to-do list—they own the process from start to finish, spot opportunities to make things better, and take pride in being the person everyone can count on

You will report directly to the**Associate VP/Executive Producer for INVNT’s Higher Ed Division. Position is based in NYC and does require three days a week in the office.**

Salary is $65k-72k.

**What You’ll Own**

* **Freelance Team Onboarding:** Drive the end-to-end onboarding process for freelance team members, ensuring paperwork, systems access, logistics, and communications are handled seamlessly.
* **Event & Crew Logistics:** Coordinate travel, accommodations, schedules, credentials, and other logistics for event teams and crew.
* **Team Operations:** Create and maintain systems and processes that keep the division organized, efficient, and running smoothly.
* **Digital Organization:** Own team digital files, folders, documentation, and organizational systems so information is easy to find and always up to date.
* **Marketing Support:** Provide administrative and operational support for marketing initiatives, projects, materials, and deadlines.
* **Process Ownership:** Identify gaps, build better workflows, document processes, and proactively solve operational challenges.
* **Day-to-Day Team Support:** Be the go-to person for the details that keep the team moving—from scheduling and coordination to last-minute needs and everything in between.
* **Anticipating Needs:** Stay one step ahead. See what's coming, identify what could go wrong, and address it before it becomes a problem.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Exceptional organizational skills and an almost obsessive attention to detail.
* A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset—you naturally think, *“What’s next?”*
* Someone who genuinely enjoys creating order, structure, and systems.
* Strong project and time-management skills with the ability to juggle multiple priorities without losing the details.
* Excellent communication skills and the confidence to coordinate across teams, vendors, freelancers, and partners.
* A high level of ownership, accountability, and follow-through.
* Comfort working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly.
* Resourcefulness and good judgment—you know when to figure something out yourself and when to ask for help.
* Strong technology and digital organization skills; you’re comfortable learning new tools and systems.
* Events, experiential, entertainment, creative, or agency experience is a plus.

**The Ideal Person**

You’re the person who always knows where the file is, remembers the detail everyone else forgot, and has already thought three steps ahead.

You’re energized by making other people more effective. You don’t wait to be told what needs to happen; you see it, own it, and get it done. In short: you’re an administrative ninja, a logistics pro, a process owner, and the person everyone wants on their team.

Travel is not anticipated for this role, however there may be occasions where presence on site is recommended.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Program Coordinator, STARS CGI supports the coordination, implementation, and growth of the Sports Training and Role Models for Success Citywide Girls Initiative (STARS CGI), a coalition of 10 nonprofit organizations expanding opportunities for girls, young women, and gender-expansive youth from systemically underserved communities across New York City. As lead agency, PowerPlay strengthens collaboration and collective impact across all five boroughs and 51 NYC Council districts.

Reporting to the Director of Programs, the Coordinator serves as a key day-to-day liaison for coalition partners and supports shared initiatives, citywide events, stakeholder engagement, communications, and grant reporting. The role also coordinates the STARS CGI Youth Leadership Council (YLC)/Fellows Program, supporting recruitment, participation, youth-led initiatives, leadership development, and civic engagement.

The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, collaborative, and skilled in relationship building, project coordination, communication, and youth development, with a strong commitment to gender and racial equity.

For more information please visit: https://www.powerplaynyc.org

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

The following responsibilities are representative; other duties may be assigned.

**Coalition Management and Relationship Engagement**

* Serve as the primary day-to-day liaison for the 10 coalition partners; coordinate communication, planning, action items, and follow-through.
* Build strong relationships with coalition members, NYC Council stakeholders, community organizations, schools, vendors, youth, families, and external partners.
* Support the Director of Programs in strengthening partner engagement, identifying collaboration opportunities, and advancing shared initiatives within established strategic priorities.

**Program, Event, and Youth Leadership Coordination**

* Coordinate coalition programs, annual initiatives, youth events, partner convenings, and citywide opportunities spanning leadership, wellness, academics, STEM, college readiness, sports, and the arts.

* Track project milestones, deliverables, partner contributions, vendor needs, marketing requirements, and implementation plans; move day-to-day initiatives forward independently within Director-established priorities.
* Facilitate coordination among PowerPlay, coalition partners, and internal programs, development, communications, finance, operations, and executive leadership teams.
* Maintain coalition communication systems, meeting agendas and notes, shared calendars, partner updates, youth outreach, action items, and follow-up materials.

**Reporting, Evaluation, and Impact**

* Maintain accurate records of partner deliverables, program activities, youth participation, event attendance, meetings, communications, and supporting documentation.
* Support grant reporting, data collection, partner reporting templates, evaluation, and impact storytelling for funders, stakeholders, and leadership.
* Collect program outcomes, participant stories, testimonials, and partner highlights for communications, advocacy, fundraising, and impact reporting.
* Gather feedback from youth, families, partners, staff, and stakeholders to improve accessibility, engagement, quality, and outcomes; prepare progress reports and recommendations.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience coordinating programs, partnerships, coalitions, youth development initiatives, community events, or related nonprofit activities.

**COMPUTER SKILLS**

Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, and ability to learn new software.

With caring and great resources at hand, we know what it takes to help people live fuller, happier, healthier lives. Under the general direction of the program director or designee, the Residence Program Specialist is responsible for supporting the care, development, and independence of individuals living in an ADAPT Community Network residential facility. * Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

As the leading global type 1 diabetes (T1D) research and advocacy organization, Breakthrough T1D helps make everyday life with T1D better while driving toward cures. We invest in the most promising research to turn ideas into life-changing therapies and devices. We work with government, regulatory officials, and insurance companies to address issues that impact the T1D community - breaking through barriers that limit access to care worldwide. We provide resources and guidance that makes it easier to live and thrive with T1D. This is more than a moment - we're empowering a movement for the T1D community. Share your support and help educate and empower individuals facing type 1 diabetes.

Our mission is to improve lives today and tomorrow by accelerating life changing breakthroughs to treat, prevent and ultimately, cure T1D and its complications. **Always, we are guided by a single purpose: As we drive towards curing type 1 diabetes, we help make everyday life better for the people who face it** .

**Position Summary**

  

Reporting to the Senior Manager of Multimedia and Digital Content, you assist with behind the scenes video work: the person who helps turn a request into a finished, on-brand video, on schedule. You support the intake of video requests, coordination of in-studio, remote, and on-location shoot, and keep scripts, reviews, approvals, and deliverables moving. You also support post-production and keep our video assets organized and easy to find. Working across Marketing, Development, Advocacy, Research, Medical Affairs, Chapters, and Events, you help ensure every video reflects one consistent Breakthrough T1D brand and supports our overall marketing strategy.

  

**As part of this position, you will:**

* Support in-house studio, remote, and on-location productions, including setup, filming support, and wrap.

* Handle scheduling and logistics for on-site and remote shoots, including talent and stakeholder coordination, locations, equipment, run-of-show, and travel.

* Gather and organize the source content each project needs, such as photos, footage, data, quotes, and approved messaging.

* Assist with post-production, including ensuring final delivery in the formats each channel requires, and cataloging of finished and raw digital assets so they can be found and reused.

* Perform quality control on all final deliverables, checking accuracy, brand and style consistency, audio and visual quality, captions, and accessibility before anything is released.

* Operate professional video equipment for in-office filming.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to keep video content consistent with Breakthrough T1D brand guidelines and aligned with our overall marketing strategy.

* Travel to film off-site as needed. Travel is occasional.

Perform other video production duties as assigned.  

  

How You’ll Spend Your Time

**Time**

**60%**

**Production Support and Logistics**

Supporting studio, remote, and on-location shoots; scheduling talent, locations, and equipment; operating video equipment; and travel as needed.

**40%**

**Post-Production, Quality Control, and Asset Management**

Assisting with editing and delivery, quality-checking final deliverables, and cataloging digital assets.

Engagement Details

* **Structure:** Independent contractor engagement. Hours are approximately 40 horus per week, with flexibility based on project load.

* **Schedule:** In the New York City office as needed based on production schedule. Remaining hours are remote.

* **Travel:** Availability to film off-site is required. Travel is occasional.

  

**You’re Good At**

* **Organization and prioritization:** You keep many projects moving at once, set realistic timelines, and hold stakeholders to them without losing goodwill.

* **Attention to detail:** You catch the details others miss, from a misspelled name on a lower third to a missing caption or an off-brand color.

* **Production logistics:** You coordinate people, locations, equipment, and schedules so that shoot days run smoothly.

* **Collaboration:** You work easily with colleagues across departments, take feedback in stride, and consolidate competing input into clear direction.

* **Composure under deadlines:** You stay calm and solution-oriented when a schedule shifts or a shoot day does not go as planned.

  

**You Bring (Qualifications** )

* 2 or more years of relevant experience in video production, production coordination, or a related role, in-house or agency-side.

* Hands-on experience supporting studio, remote, and on-location shoots, including scheduling and logistics.

* Experience operating professional video equipment such as cameras, lighting, and audio.

* Working knowledge of video editing and post-production workflows, and the ability to support an editor with delivery and file management.

* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize competing requests and meet tight deadlines.

* Strong written communication skills, and a high level of attention to detail and quality control.

* Comfort using project management and digital asset management tools.

* Availability to work in the New York City office as needed and to travel occasionally for off-site shoots.

jobs.title: Office & Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Shark Byte Systems Inc. (SBS)**

Shark Byte Systems Inc. (SBS) is an innovative computer vision and artificial intelligence company headquartered in New York City. We build robust, real-time visual intelligence systems and inference models deployed to solve complex operational challenges. Our technical culture is hands-on, high-ownership, and run strictly on Linux infrastructure.

**Role Summary**

Shark Byte Systems Inc. (SBS) is looking for an organized, technically grounded, and proactive Office & Operations Coordinator to serve as the operational backbone for both our NYC office and day-to-day technical workflows.

In this multifaceted role, you will bridge day-to-day office operations with ongoing technical execution. You will work closely with our field technicians and software engineers, managing incoming support queues, directing task assignments, monitoring project milestones, purchasing hardware and project equipment, handling location-setup billing transactions, and keeping our workplace running without friction. Because we do not run rigid sprint cycles, our work centers on continuous delivery, quick triage, and clear ticket prioritization.

The ideal candidate brings familiarity with a Linux-centric engineering workplace, communicates effortlessly across technical teams, and keeps projects moving forward in a fast-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities1. Technical Task Coordination & Support Operations**

* **Task & Queue Management:** Manage ongoing technician assignments, monitor day-to-day workload capacity, and maintain clear task status visibility using Jira.
* **Support Ticket Ownership:** Act as the first line for support ticket triage; prioritize incoming issues, direct assignments to the right technical specialists, follow up on blockers, and track issues to resolution.
* **Operational Syncs & Standups:** Organize and facilitate regular status check-ins, technician handoffs, and priority reviews via Google Meet.
* **Team Communication:** Keep operational channels clear, organized, and up to date using Slack (ticket updates, incident coordination, and field tech announcements).
* **Process Improvement:** Continuously refine ticketing pipelines, intake forms, and resolution workflows to reduce turnaround times and support our technicians effectively.

**2. Project Procurement & Location Billing Operations**

* **Project Equipment Purchasing:** Source, order, and track delivery of specialized hardware, cameras, sensors, cabling, tools, and technical gear required for client deployments and technician project rollouts.
* **Payment Gateway Management:** Administer merchant gateways/payment portals to process customer credit card charges for initial location onboarding.
* **Billing Records & Expense Tracking:** Maintain accurate purchase orders, receipts, transaction records, and invoice logs reconciled with the accounting team.

**3. Office & Workplace Administration**

* **NYC Workplace Logistics:** Manage on-site office operations, desk setups, supply inventory, shipping/receiving of gear, and overall facility readiness.
* **Vendor & Facilities Liaison:** Serve as the point of contact for NYC building management, facilities personnel, maintenance, and internet/utility service providers.
* **Onboarding & Workstation Staging:** Partner with technical leads to coordinate workstation preparation (hardware procurement, seating, access passes) and schedule first-week onboarding for new team members.
* **Company Culture & Events:** Organize team lunches, tech demonstrations, client site visits, and team social events.

**Qualifications & SkillsCore Qualifications (Must-Haves)**

* **Location:** Based in the Greater New York City area with the ability to work on-site at our NYC office.
* **Relevant Experience:** 2–5 years of experience in project management, technical operations coordination, or office administration within a tech company, IT services provider, or fast-paced startup.
* **Jira & Ticket Management:** Practical hands-on experience structuring Kanban boards, managing ticket queues, writing clear issue summaries, and tracking ticket lifecycles in Jira.
* **Procurement & Financial Admin:** Experience managing purchasing/procurement pipelines for equipment and navigating credit card payment gateways/billing tools (e.g., Stripe, Authorize.net, Square, or similar merchant platforms).
* **Modern Collaboration Tools:** Proficiency with Slack (channel administration, thread organization) and Google Workspace (Google Meet, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Calendar).
* **Communication & Multi-Tasking:** Exceptional written and verbal communication; ability to balance office logistics alongside fast-moving technical ticket queues and purchasing requests.
* **Project Methodology:** Experience with continuous flow, Kanban, or ITIL-style incident and support queue management.

**Familiarity & Nice-to-Haves**

* **Linux Familiarity:** Familiarity with or comfort working in a Linux-centric environment (including basic command-line interface literacy or shell basics, such as Ubuntu or Debian), as SBS operates on Linux systems and servers.
* **Hardware & Network Familiarity:** Prior exposure to or general familiarity with network routers, switches, and cameras is a plus.

**Benefits & Perks**

* **Competitive Compensation:** Competitive base salary, commensurate with experience.
* **Commuter Support:** Pre-tax commuter benefits (MTA / transit passes).
* **Time Off:** Paid time off (PTO) plus standard holidays.
* **Health Insurance:** Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance coverage.

Pay: $70,000.00 - $90,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

About America Works

America Works is a pioneer and recognized leader in workforce development. As a 100% woman-owned business, America Works brings a people-first perspective to everything it does.

What has remained constant throughout the organization's history is its commitment to the people it serves and the people who make its mission possible. Joining America Works means becoming part of an organization with a respected reputation, an established model for success, and a mission that makes a meaningful difference in people's lives.

Position Overview

America Works is seeking a friendly, organized, and dependable Front Desk & Administrative Coordinator to support daily office operations and assist with client engagement. This individual will serve as one of the first points of contact for clients and visitors while providing administrative support, conducting outbound client outreach, and assisting with special projects and program activities.

The position will work closely with our Ticket to Work program, which supports individuals receiving Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) and Supplemental Security Income (SSI) benefits who are interested in exploring employment opportunities.

The ideal candidate is customer-service oriented, detail-oriented, comfortable communicating with clients over the phone, and able to balance front desk responsibilities with administrative and project-based assignments.

Key Responsibilities

* Front Desk & Reception: Greet and assist clients and visitors, answer incoming calls, direct inquiries, and maintain a welcoming and professional office environment.

* Administrative Support: Provide general administrative assistance, including scanning, filing, organizing documents, maintaining records, and supporting daily office operations.

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.

* Comfortable making outbound calls and interacting with clients.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

* Ability to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and work in a fast-paced office environment.

* Professional, approachable, and dependable demeanor.

We are looking for someone who enjoys working with people, takes initiative, and is comfortable balancing administrative responsibilities with direct client interaction. The successful candidate will play an important role in keeping the office organized, supporting program operations, and ensuring clients receive timely and professional assistance.

jobs.description:
Since 1891, New York's Carnegie Hall has set the international standard for excellence in performance, presenting exceptional concerts by the world’s finest artists on its three iconic stages, from orchestral concerts, chamber music, contemporary offerings, and recitals to jazz, world, and popular music. Complementing its performance activities, Carnegie Hall’s Weill Music Institute creates extensive music education and social impact programs that annually serve more than 800,000 people worldwide, playing a central role in fulfilling Carnegie Hall's commitment to making great music accessible to as many people as possible.
  
  
**Department:** Development
  
**Title of Position:** Coordinator, Special Events
  
**Reports to Position:** Director, Special Events
  
**Job Classification:** Full-time, Non-Exempt
  
  
**Scope of Responsibilities:**  
Carnegie Hall seeks an organized, detail-oriented, and service-minded Coordinator to join the Special Events team within its Development department. As the junior member of a high-functioning, five-person team, the Coordinator provides essential fundraising, administrative, and event support for Carnegie Hall's premier fundraising galas (approximately 3–4 each season) and its donor cultivation and stewardship events throughout the season.
  
Reporting to the Director of Special Events, the Coordinator will work closely with the Assistant Directors and Senior Associate to ensure that gifts are processed accurately and acknowledged promptly, that donor communications and solicitation mailings are implemented smoothly, and that the departmental calendars, materials, and financial processes run efficiently. This position is an outstanding opportunity for an emerging professional to build a strong foundation in non-profit fundraising and event management at one of the world's most celebrated cultural institutions.
  
The Coordinator is often a first point of contact for donors, patrons, and colleagues, so thoughtful, courteous, and responsive communication is essential to the role.
  
  
**Tasks & Responsibilities:**  
Gift Processing & Donor Stewardship
  

* Serve as the primary processor of gift entry for galas as assigned, recording gifts and donor information in the database and preparing timely acknowledgments and tax receipts.
* Serve as the primary contact for collecting and maintaining accurate guest names and contact information for gala attendees.
* Provide back-up gift entry support for additional galas, and draft donor confirmation emails as needed.

Solicitation & Communications Support
  

* Support gala solicitation efforts by building and segmenting mailing and invitation lists and implementing donor mailings.
* Support the creation and implementation of print and web materials, including drafting copy, conducting initial proofreading and review, and routing materials for approval.

Event Production Support
  

* Maintain the team's production calendar and a calendar of competing events, helping anticipate scheduling conflicts and key deadlines.
* Manage the complimentary guest process for galas.
* Coordinate photography and videography to document events and capture content for future use. Serve as the point person for all photography/videography projects and related donor requests.

Administrative & Financial Operations
  

* Monitor the team's general email inbox and phone hotline, responding to patron and colleague inquiries promptly and professionally.
* Process vendor invoices and reconcile a department credit card.
* Assist with post-event gala analysis to evaluate results and inform future planning.

**Skills & Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor's degree preferred
* 1 year of internship or professional experience in fundraising, preferably in events and/or non-profit
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, understand how to prioritize workload, and be detail-oriented in a fast-paced work environment
* Computer and database skills needed, including mail merges in Microsoft Word and familiarity with Microsoft Excel. Knowledge of non-profit software a plus (such as Tessitura or Raiser's Edge)

Even if you do not match 100% of this experience, we encourage and value diverse backgrounds and welcome anyone with a passion for this type of work to apply.
  
  
To apply please submit a COVER LETTER with your resume.

jobs.title: Customer Success Consultant
jobs.description:

organization and embodying empathy, technical skills, and organizational savvy to get the members quickly to the solutions they need while promoting the MetroPlusHealth brand and ensure a successful  
outcome in member retention and satisfaction.
