jobs.title: Customer Marketing Associate
jobs.description:
Reejig is the Work Operating System for the AI powered enterprise.

We give companies a complete, validated view of their work by mapping every role, task, skill, and workflow. With this intelligence, we redesign how work should flow, surface where automation creates the highest leverage, and recommend the right AI agents for the enterprise.

Every change is measured and tied to real operational and workforce impact.

Inside Reejig, we build the same future we sell. We are developing our own AI powered workforce that supports our teams and our customers.

This is a place for builders who want to help define how work will operate in the AI era.

**The Role**

We work with some of the world's most influential leaders in AI, HR and workforce transformation.

We're looking for a Customer Marketing Associate to help our customers feel connected to Reejig — making sure their success gets celebrated, their stories get heard, and the relationship keeps growing.

You'll work closely with Marketing, Customer Success and Sales to run the campaigns and programmes that engage our customers throughout their journey with Reejig. Over time, you'll get to know our customers well — who their champions are, what they're trying to achieve, and where there's an opportunity to deepen the relationship.

And when a customer is doing something great with Reejig, you'll work with Customer Success to help find that story, capture it, and turn it into something the rest of the market can see.

This is an early career role with a lot of room to grow. We're looking for someone curious, organised and customer-obsessed who wants to learn how a customer marketing function comes together.

**What You Will Own**

**Customer Engagement**

* **Customer lifecycle campaigns.** Run thoughtful campaigns that engage customers at the moments that matter - from the moment they join Reejig through onboarding, key milestones, launches, expansions, anniversaries and renewals.
* **Customer moments.** Find ways to make our customers feel recognised and part of what we're building. Celebrate their people and the work they're pioneering.
* **Customer communications.** Make sure customers know what's happening at Reejig and have opportunities to engage with our thinking, products, events and people - without filling their inbox with generic marketing.

**Customer Intelligence**

* Work with Customer Success and Sales to understand our accounts - who's involved, what they care about, what they're trying to achieve
* Keep account maps up to date, and flag where we have gaps in relationships

**Customer Proof**

* Stay close to Customer Success to help identify outcomes, quotes and moments worth sharing
* Help turn customer conversations, results and milestones into stories, testimonials, quotes and sales evidence
* Work with Content, Social, Sales, PR and Events to help our best customer stories get seen

**Customer Advocacy**

* Help build and maintain a list of customers open to sharing their experience with Reejig
* Support opportunities for customers to have a voice — webinars, events, references, media

**What Good Looks Like at 90 Days**

* You know our customers - their priorities, champions, key stakeholders and where the strongest opportunities sit.
* Every strategic customer has a current account map showing where relationships are strong and where we need to build them.
* A clear customer marketing calendar is live across lifecycle campaigns, customer moments and communications.
* We have a visible pipeline of customer stories, proof points and advocacy opportunities.
* Our strongest customer stories are consistently being turned into proof that Marketing and Sales can use.
* Customer Success, Sales and Marketing have a simple operating rhythm for sharing customer intelligence and identifying opportunities.

**Who You Are**

* You have some experience in marketing, customer success, content, or another customer-facing role - internships count. We care more about curiosity and potential than years of experience.
* You're genuinely curious about customers - you want to understand what they're trying to achieve and what makes them excited about working with a company.
* You're a solid writer and communicator, and you're keen to get better at turning what you hear into a clear story.
* You're organised - you can keep track of details across a few accounts at once without dropping things.
* You're proactive - if you spot something worth flagging, you say something rather than waiting to be asked.
* You like working with people - customers, Customer Success, Sales - and you're comfortable asking questions to learn.
* You want to build a career in customer marketing, and you're excited to learn from a small, fast-moving team.

**Why This Matters**

Reejig is at a point of real inflection. We are building a company that will reshape how organisations operate in the AI era. The people who join now are not stepping into a role, they are stepping into a chance to build something with scale and long term impact. If you want work that changes your career and creates meaningful equity upside, this is the moment.

*The expected annual base salary for this role is $65,000–$85,000 USD, depending on experience, plus equity.*

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (Investor Experience)
jobs.description:
**About Frec**
--------------

Frec is building the modern investment platform for high-net-worth investors. We combine self-directed investing with continuously managed strategies in a single brokerage account, bringing capabilities traditionally delivered through wealth managers directly to our customers.

We see AI as a way to make sophisticated investing more personal and intuitive. The investment infrastructure we’ve already built gives us a foundation to help customers make better decisions without giving up control of their financial lives.

Customers have entrusted us with $1.5 billion in assets, up 4x in the last year. We’re backed by Greylock and have reached this scale with a small team. The people who join now will help build the primary investment platform for a new generation of investors.

**The role**
------------

As an early member of Frec's Investor Experience team, you'll play a critical role in building lasting customer relationships and shaping how we serve investors as we scale.

You'll own the post-onboarding customer relationship, acting as a knowledgeable and trusted point of contact for investors with increasingly sophisticated financial needs. Your goal is to ensure customers understand the value of Frec’s investment strategies, feel confident using our platform, and have an exceptional experience throughout their relationship with Frec.

This role requires investment fluency, analytical thinking, strong relationship management skills, and the ability to make complex financial concepts accessible. You'll help customers understand everything from direct indexing and tax-loss harvesting to long short strategies, portfolio leverage, financing costs, and investment performance.

Beyond working directly with customers, you'll help build the systems, processes, and standards that define how Frec delivers an exceptional investor experience at scale.

**What you'll do**

* Own the post-onboarding customer relationship, building trust and driving long-term engagement, satisfaction, and retention.
* Help investors understand their portfolios, investment strategies, performance, tax-loss harvesting, fees, and financing costs.
* Investigate complex customer issues, taking ownership from initial discovery through resolution.
* Partner with product, engineering, and brokerage operations to identify root causes, prioritize improvements, and resolve issues.
* Identify early signs of customer dissatisfaction or disengagement and develop strategies to address them.

* Own and improve key customer experience metrics, including NPS, CSAT, customer health, retention, and response times.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation, AI, and better processes.
* Collect and synthesize customer feedback to influence product development and business priorities.
* Partner with sales and marketing to create a seamless experience across the entire customer journey.

**What you bring**
------------------

* 4+ years of experience in wealth management, brokerage, fintech, customer success, or a related client-facing financial services role.
* SIE, Series 7, and either Series 65 or Series 66 credentials in good standing.
* Strong understanding of financial markets, investment products, brokerage accounts, margin, leverage, and financing costs.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build credibility with sophisticated investors.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and meticulous attention to detail.
* Experience working with CRM and customer engagement platforms, such as HubSpot.
* A proactive, ownership-oriented approach. You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, investigating problems independently, and building processes where they don't yet exist.
* A bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base salary with performance-based bonus opportunities
* Meaningful equity ownership in a fast-growing company
* Fully covered health and dental insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Monthly wellness stipend to support physical and mental health
* Flexible paid time off
* Daily in office lunch
* The opportunity to build and shape a core function at an early-stage fintech company

Startup experience as well as familiarity with direct index and tax loss harvesting concepts is a plus! If you’ve worked in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement listed.

Must be able to work on-site 4 days/week from either NYC or SF

Compensation Range: $130K - $170K

jobs.title: SDR (Sales Development Representative)
jobs.description:
**About Zip Security**
======================

Cybersecurity for growing businesses is broken — even enterprises spend heavily across hundreds of disconnected tools for marginal real-world benefit. For startups and mid-sized firms, this gap often means forgoing security entirely, or cobbling together a solution that leaves them vulnerable in other ways. At Zip Security, we build solutions that make enterprise cybersecurity effective and doable for growing businesses of all kinds, whether or not they have a security team in house.  
  
Our product is a complete security program that automates device management, endpoint security, identity and access management, compliance, and managed IT and security operations to keep teams of all kinds protected. We help our customers pick their right security frameworks, correctly deploy the tools, policies, and controls they need, and keep everything enforced over time, so their business is protected and compliant, 24/7.

Zip is at the cutting edge of what’s possible in cybersecurity, and dedicated to delivering value for our customers. It’s a big part of why we’re backed by Ballistic Ventures. Major platforms are opening APIs that enable automated management at scale, new government initiatives are surfacing global threat data, and we're positioned to be the first to properly integrate all of it. We're looking for driven, talented people to help us get there. If this resonates with you, we invite you to consider building alongside our team.

**About The Role**
==================

As a **Sales Development Representative (SDR) at Zip Security**, you’ll have the opportunity to kick-start your sales career at a rapidly growing cybersecurity startup. Having built our founding cohort of SDRs, we're excited to continue scaling our team with ambitious, hardworking individuals who are eager to learn, challenge themselves, and grow alongside us.

You'll be on the front lines of our go-to-market efforts, connecting with prospective customers, uncovering business challenges, and generating meaningful opportunities for our sales team. As Zip continues to scale, our SDR team will play a pivotal role in our international expansion, helping us break into new markets and build our global presence. You'll work closely with Account Executives, Marketing, and Sales Leadership, receiving hands-on coaching and developing the foundational skills to build a successful career in sales.

**Your career path at Zip is yours to build.** Whether you aspire to become an Account Executive, grow into sales leadership, explore partnerships, or pursue another area of our go-to-market organization, we're excited to help you build the foundation to get there. As Zip grows, we want you to grow with us.

**What You Will Build at Zip Security**
---------------------------------------

* Generate new business opportunities through outbound prospecting across phone, email, and LinkedIn.
* Research prospective customers and develop an understanding of their business and security challenges.
* Play a key role in Zip's international expansion by identifying opportunities, engaging prospective customers, and helping establish our presence in new markets.
* Build strong prospecting, cold-calling, discovery, and objection-handling skills through hands-on experience and coaching.
* Qualify prospective customers and book high-quality meetings for Account Executives, contributing directly to Zip's growth.
* Collaborate with Sales and Marketing to experiment with messaging, targeting, and outbound strategies.
* Take ownership of your performance, track your progress, and consistently work toward exceeding your goals.
* Contribute ideas and help shape the culture and processes of our growing sales development team.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* You have **0–1 years of professional experience**. Recent graduates are encouraged to apply.
* You're ambitious, hardworking, and genuinely excited about building a career in sales.
* You're naturally curious, personable, and enjoy connecting with new people.
* You're a strong communicator who is excited to pick up the phone and engage with prospective customers.
* You're resilient, persistent, and motivated by challenges rather than discouraged by setbacks.
* You're highly coachable, receptive to feedback, and committed to continuous improvement.
* You're competitive and goal-oriented while also being invested in the success of your teammates.

We believe great teams are built by curious people who care deeply about learning, collaboration, and ownership. At Zip Security, you’ll have the autonomy to contribute ideas, shape decisions, and help build both our product and our culture. If you’re excited about the role, we encourage you to apply — even if your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every qualification.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive compensation and comprehensive health benefits starting on day one
* 401(k) plan to help you invest in your future
* Flexible hybrid work environment (2-3 days in office! You decide what is best for you!)
* Monthly wellness benefits to help you stay active, healthy, and balanced in whatever way works best for you
* Comprehensive family-building, fertility, and hormonal health benefits to support you through every stage of life
* High ownership, autonomy, and the opportunity to shape a rapidly growing company
* Fully stocked office with endless snacks, coffee, and tea, plus Zip swag and team outings

**Standard Interview Process**
------------------------------

* Initial Screen with Talent Partner
* Hiring Manager Screen
* Technical or Team Interview
* Executive Interview
* Offer

Compensation Range: $65K - $90K

jobs.title: Retail Design and Construction Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Help shape how a national retail design and construction organization operates. You will unite internal teams and service providers around clear standards, strong governance, and decision-ready information, while advising senior leaders on outcomes, risks, and priorities.

As a Business Operations Lead Manager on the Retail Design and Construction (RD&C) team, you will lead business operations for a multi-billion-dollar retail construction program delivered across the 48 contiguous states. You will bring 50 internal professionals and more than 400 external specialists across three real estate service providers into one operating model. You will set the roadmap for process, governance, technology, data, financial discipline, and staffing, and serve as the senior operations point of accountability for service-provider performance. You will represent RD&C to business leaders and stakeholders across the bank, and partner with other Global Real Estate (GRE) functions worldwide to keep practices consistent. This highly visible role offers the opportunity to build an operations function that becomes a model for the broader organization and the industry.

**Job responsibilities**

* Define and evolve the operating model and multi-year roadmap for process, governance, technology, data, and staffing.
* Set measurable operating standards, benchmark performance against industry leaders, and drive continuous improvement.
* Standardize design and project management processes and reporting across internal teams and service partners.

* Act as a trusted partner to senior bank leaders and business clients and represent RD&C in executive forums, providing clear updates on outcomes, risks, trade-offs, and decisions needed, supported by executive-ready materials.

* Experience working with technology teams on software integrations and application programming.

We also help small businesses, nonprofits and cities grow, delivering solutions to solve all their financial needs.

jobs.title: Client Relationship Manager - Banking and Financial Services
jobs.description:
**Client Relationship Manager – Banking and Financial Services**
================================================================

**New York**

**About us**
------------

The Financial Times is one of the world's leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you're given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you'll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you'll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

**Our commitment to inclusion and fairness**
--------------------------------------------

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.

We want every application to receive fair and thoughtful consideration; therefore, all applications are reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, not by AI.

**The role**
------------

The Reader Revenue Group (RRG) unites the subscription and licensing businesses of the Financial Times, creating opportunities to build broader, deeper and longer-term relationships with organisations around the world.

Within RRG, Corporate Licensing provides FT content to organisations worldwide through solutions ranging from group and enterprise subscriptions to customised data feeds. Our Americas team works collaboratively to strengthen customer relationships and drive sustainable commercial growth.

We are looking for a Client Relationship Manager to manage and grow a portfolio of customers within our Banking and Financial Services team across the Americas.

In this role, you will take ownership of customer retention, revenue growth and renewal activity, building strong relationships with key stakeholders and identifying opportunities to expand existing accounts. You'll work closely with customers to understand their needs, demonstrate the value of FT products and services, and deliver long-term commercial value.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong customer-facing and commercial experience who is looking to develop their career in account management. You'll need to be confident managing multiple priorities, building relationships and taking ownership of commercial objectives.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Deliver agreed retention and revenue growth targets, taking ownership of portfolio performance and renewal activity.

jobs.title: Vendor Operations Associate, Accounts Payable
jobs.description:
Order.co is the System of Action for the Office of the CFO, transforming the way businesses purchase and pay into an intuitive, B2C-like shopping experience. Order.co leverages embedded AI agents and embedded financial products to reinvent the way businesses connect with their vendors.

End users enjoy a seamless, zero-training buying experience, while finance and procurement leaders gain a single platform to orchestrate how the business “should operate”. The result is an all-in-one solution that serves as a gravitational pull for spend and data, automating and eliminating procurement and finance workflows from requisition to reconciliation along the way.

Order.co is on the cutting edge of B2B Agentic Commerce, poised to be the market leader in creating a more predictive, prescriptive, and personalized experience for users.

Founded in 2016 and headquartered in New York City, Order.co oversees nearly half a billion in annualized spend across hundreds of customers like WeWork, SoulCycle, Lume, and [solidcore]. Order.co has raised $75M in funding from industry-leading investors like MIT, Stage 2 Capital, Rally Ventures, 645 Ventures, and more. Order.co has been proudly named a 50 to Watch by Spend Matters and a Best Place to Work by BuiltIn and Inc. Magazine.

Order.co is looking for a Vendor Operations Associate, Accounts Payable to own our day-to-day accounts payable work: managing the AP inbox, paying vendor invoices accurately and on time by credit card and ACH, reconciling statements, and resolving payment issues quickly.

This is an early career role ideal for someone who enjoys problem solving, investigating issues, and working with people. You'll spend your day working through the AP inbox, processing invoice payments, reconciling vendor statements, and working with vendors and teammates to resolve discrepancies.

The role sits within our Vendor Operations organization and works closely with Accounts Payable, Fulfillment Operations, Customer Success, and our offshore operations team.

We're looking for someone who is curious, organized, accountable, and excited to learn. Prior experience in procurement, accounts payable, or vendor management is encourage but not required.

**What You'll Do**

Own and Monitor the Accounts Payable Function

* Manage the Accounts Payable inbox: triage incoming invoices, statements, and vendor inquiries, respond promptly, and escalate as needed.
* Pay vendor invoices by credit card and ACH, confirming amounts, payment details, and due dates before each payment goes out
* Reconcile invoices and vendor statements against orders and payment records
* Clarify irregular invoice items with vendors and internal teams and resolve discrepancies before payment
* Review vendor files, net terms, and payment history to ensure timely payments

Work Directly with Vendors

* Communicate with vendors to resolve order issues, payment issues, and fulfillment questions
* Help vendors understand and comply with Order.co purchasing and fulfillment processes
* Identify recurring vendor behaviors that create operational challenges and work toward long-term solutions
* Build productive relationships with vendor contacts while representing Order.co professionally

Drive Continuous Improvement

* Look for patterns and recurring issues across vendors, orders, and workflows
* Suggest improvements and automations that reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency
* Collaborate with offshore team members to ensure work is completed accurately and on time
* Contribute to process documentation and operational best practices

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong attention to detail and follow-through, especially with invoice data, payment amounts, and vendor details
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to stay organized while managing multiple priorities efficiently
* Comfortable solving problems independently and asking questions when needed
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn
* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, including formulas, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, and sorting and filtering large data sets
* Comfortable with email and business software

**Why This Role Matters**

Every day, thousands of orders flow through the Order.co platform. While many are automated, some require investigation, coordination, and problem solving to ensure successful completion.

This role serves as a critical bridge between customers, vendors, and internal teams, helping ensure vendors are paid accurately and on time, orders are fulfilled, vendors remain compliant with our processes, and operational issues are resolved before they impact the customer experience.

It's an opportunity to develop valuable skills in accounts payable, operations, vendor management, procurement, and process improvement while making an immediate impact on the business.

**What You'll Receive**
-----------------------

* A competitive compensation package including stock options
* Employer-sponsored 401(k) with employer match
* Robust medical, dental, vision, and wellness benefits
* Flexible time off and remote work policies
* Generous leave policies and support for new and current parents
* The anticipated hourly rate for this role is $25-$27/hour. Actual compensation and title will be commensurate with experience, qualifications, knowledge, and skills.

jobs.description:
Vestwell is the financial technology company powering the new savings economy. The New York City-based fintech platform redefines how people save for the critical aspects of life across retirement, education, and healthcare savings needs. Today, Vestwell enables over 790,000 businesses and more than 2.75 million active savers, with over $57 billion in assets saved across all 50 United States.

Vestwell offers a range of products, including workplace-delivered retirement plans, employer-offered student loan repayment benefits, and various savings accounts for education, emergencies, and individuals with disabilities.

Vestwell's platform serves a diverse clientele, including financial advisers, employers, third-party administrators, financial institutions, payroll providers, government agencies, and individual savers. To learn more, visit vestwell.com

**Who Are We Looking For?**

At Vestwell, we know that the key to growth is a high-performing sales team. That's why we're seeking a qualified Sales Development Representative (SDR) to find and screen potential customers who could benefit from our range of financial wellness products and services. As the first line of communication with a prospect, the ideal SDR has a strong understanding of the sales methodology and excels at:

* Engaging new clients through high volume calls and call cadences
* Driving qualification, urgency and intent
* Creating effective sales meetings for sales closers that optimize prospect conversion

Vestwell SDRs should be a quick learner who has strong communication skills and an ability to showcase our offerings in a compelling way. SDRs are generally in this role between 6-9 months. After month 9, successful SDRs are eligible for promotion into full cycle, closing roles.

**What Will You Be Doing?**

* Represent the company's products and services & deliver Vestwell's value proposition to new prospects, including both financial advisors and business owners.
* Qualify prospects, build intent & generate new meetings for sales through outbound calling.
* Manage and maintain a pipeline of interested prospects and engage sales leaders in next steps.
* Own your personal growth and development as a Vestwell sales representative by learning the financial services industry, Vestwell's range of financial wellness solutions, and the mechanics of a modern sales process.
* Ability to utilize Salesforce & Salesloft to manage lead lists.
* Understanding the Vestwell partnerships.
* Understanding the products and services Vestwell offers.
* Master talk tracks and ability to qualify prospects.
  + Identify the needs of prospects, and suggest appropriate products or services.
* Set up meetings for prospects with field sales representatives.
* Report to sales manager with weekly, monthly, and quarterly results.

**Requirements**

The Necessities

* Strong communication skills via phone and email.
* Proven, creative problem-solving approach and strong analytical skills.
* Displays self-motivation for sales coaching and development.
* Strong desire and ability to move up within a sales organization.

The Extras

* Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) or at least five years of relevant work experience.
* Previous experience in sales, with a track record of exceeding lead targets.
* Experience as a sales development representative, with a track record of achieving & exceeding sales quotas.
* Proficiency with Salesforce, Salesloft, or other CRM software.
* Financial services &/or small business sales experience.

This role will be based in our Austin or New York office, and will be part of Vestwell's hybrid in-office operation.

The expected base salary range for this position is a minimum of $55K - $60K, plus performance based variable. Please note that salary bands are based on NY and other similar metro areas and may differ based on where the role is ultimately hired.

**Full-Time Employee Benefits**  
We're an innovative, high-growth company with an exciting future ahead. At Vestwell, we prioritize employee wellbeing through comprehensive health benefits, generous time off, and a dedicated Employee Wellbeing Committee. Our hybrid work model offers flexibility while providing access to our collaborative offices in Midtown Manhattan, Austin, King of Prussia, and Scottsdale. And, of course, as a company focused on helping people save for the future, we offer a competitive 401(k) plan.

**Interview Process**  
Our interview process starts the same for every candidate with 1-2 introductory conversations to learn more about your background, interests, and what you're looking for, while also giving you the opportunity to learn more about Vestwell and the team. From there, the process varies by role but typically includes a skills or experience-based assessment, such as a coding interview, portfolio review, or deeper discussion of your relevant experience. Successful candidates then move on to a virtual or in-person interview panel. Before extending an offer, we complete a reference check with a current or former manager and a peer. Throughout the process, we prioritize transparency, clear communication, and minimizing surprises.

You will ensure that both leaders are prepared and informed on all relevant matters in a timely manner, with all correspondence, deliverables, and responses to calls and emails actioned within appropriate timeframes.

  

The ideal candidate will demonstrate exceptional organizational skills, sound judgment, the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with leaders and other executive assistants, and a strong commitment to maintaining confidentiality and discretion with sensitive business information. This role requires flexibility, strong communication skills, learning agility, an enthusiastic and collaborative spirit, and a commitment to operational excellence in support of executive leadership.

  

**We Will Count On You To:**

* Proactively manage the CPOs complex calendars across multiple time zones, prioritizing meetings and commitments to maximize effectiveness and manage competing priorities.
* Schedule in-person and virtual meetings, communicate with internal and external colleagues, and ensure seamless meeting coordination.
* Identify and lead process improvement opportunities; proactively evaluate and recommend tools and technologies (including AI-powered solutions and tools) that can enhance efficiency and effectiveness in calendar management, meeting coordination, communication, and administrative workflows.
* Prepare professional responses to routine inquiries and serve as a point of contact and liaison for the CPOs with business leaders, executive leadership, HR teams, and external stakeholders; manage inquiries and escalate as needed.
* Manage or support major events, off-sites, and gatherings for the HR team—including booking meeting rooms, organizing catering, arranging transportation, and coordinating all logistics with internal event management teams as needed.
* Coordinate comprehensive travel planning and logistics for both domestic and international travel, including booking accommodations, arranging transportation, and managing all travel arrangements and documentation.
* Manage the CPOs expense reports, budgets for the office, travel, and entertainment; maintain accurate records and ensure compliance with company policies.
* Provide coverage for other EAs who are out of the office to ensure seamless support to all senior-level employees.
* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of organizational structure, key leaders, business priorities, and operational activities to provide informed, contextual support to the CPOs.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with colleagues, stakeholders, and other executive teams; proactively identify and address stakeholder needs.
* Handle sensitive information with strict confidentiality and discretion; maintain professional and trustworthy relationships across the organization and ensure compliance with internal processes, T&E management, and event coordination standards.
  

**What You Need to Have:**

* 5+ years of experience as an executive assistant, preferably supporting C-level or senior leadership in large, global organizations
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex calendars, competing priorities, and multiple stakeholders with discretion and professionalism

jobs.description:
**Executive Assistant to the Owner, AI & Merchandising**

**\*\*\*Onsite work is required four days a week.\*\*\***

We are looking for an Executive Assistant with a strong, working understanding of AI to serve as the Owner's right hand and trusted lieutenant. The Owner leads merchandising, design, sourcing, production, and sales. This role keeps the business running smoothly around him and joins him in every business meeting.

This is not a traditional calendar-and-inbox role. The Owner is highly knowledgeable about AI and uses it daily on his phone, but does not work on a computer, email or desktop software such as Windows and Excel. The Executive Assistant will be his partner in bringing AI tools and processes into the company: turning his ideas into working computer-based workflows, handling the desktop and email side of the business, and helping the team adopt AI.

The ideal candidate also brings a flair for marketing and merchandising: an eye for product, trends and brand presentation, and a genuine interest in what makes customers buy.

**Key Responsibilities**

***AI Enablement (Top Priority)***

* Use AI tools daily to draft correspondence, summarize documents, prepare meeting notes, research vendors and markets, and organize information for the Owner.
* Work closely with the Owner on his AI vision, translating ideas he develops on his phone into tools, documents, and workflows the team uses on their computers.
* Identify everyday tasks across merchandising, design, sourcing, production, and sales where AI can save time or improve results.
* Help pilot, document and roll out new AI tools and workflows with department teams, including simple how-to guides and training.
* Follow company guidelines on confidentiality and data privacy when using AI tools and flag risks to the Owner.
* Stay current on new AI tools.

***Marketing and Merchandising Support***

* Support the Owner on merchandising decisions, including line reviews, assortment planning, pricing discussions, and sell-through tracking.
* Prepare polished product presentations, line sheets and showroom materials for buyers and customers.
* Help create marketing content such as product descriptions, social media posts, email campaigns, and sales presentations, using AI tools to draft and refine them.
* Research trends, competitors, and customer preferences, and share insights that inform design and product decisions.
* Use AI to analyze sales data and identify best sellers, slow movers, and new opportunities.
* Coordinate with design, production and sales teams on product launches, samples, and market events.

***Executive and Administrative Support***

* Manage the Owner's email, calendar, travel, and correspondence on his behalf, since he does not use email or a computer, and function as his first point of contact.
* Prepare reports, spreadsheets, presentations and briefing materials, turning information from different departments into clear summaries he can review easily on his phone.
* Handle confidential business information with discretion.

***Meetings***

* Attend all business meetings with the Owner, including internal, vendor, factory, and customer meetings.
* Prepare agendas and background materials, take notes, and distribute summaries and action items.
* Follow up on commitments made in meetings and keep the Owner informed of progress.

***Project Coordination***

* Track many projects at once across merchandising, design, sourcing, production, and sales, and keep them moving.
* Prioritize tasks based on urgency and the Owner's goals and escalate issues before they become problems.
* Serve as a liaison between the Owner and department heads, vendors, and customers.

**Qualifications**

Required: A Strong Understanding of AI

This is the most important qualification for the role. The Owner understands AI well and is looking for someone who does too: a person who knows how AI tools work, what they do well, where they fall short, and how to apply them to genuine business problems. Basic familiarity with a chatbot is not enough.

* Solid understanding of how AI tools work, including their strengths, their limits, and common errors such as confident but incorrect answers.
* Hands-on, regular use of AI assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot or Gemini for real work, not just casual experimentation.
* Ability to write clear prompts and judge AI output, checking it for accuracy before relying on it.
* Experience using AI to draft, summarize, research, analyze data or automate routine tasks.
* Awareness of the current AI landscape, including new tools and how businesses are putting them to use.
* Ability to keep up with an AI-savvy Owner, discuss AI tools and ideas at his level, and turn them into practical processes for the business.
* Understanding of the basics of responsible AI use, including protecting confidential and personal information.

**Required: Experience and Skills**

* Proven ability to manage many projects at once and prioritize under pressure.
* Personable, warm, and professional, able to build relationships with team members, vendors, and customers.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Advanced skills in Microsoft 365 (Excel, Outlook, Word, PowerPoint) or Google Workspace, since this role handles all computer-based work for the Owner.
* High discretion with confidential business information.
* Self-starter who anticipates needs and works independently while the Owner travels.

***Preferred***

jobs.title: Local Store Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Based in metro Atlanta. Field-based: you drive between our stores and prospects across the Atlanta and north Georgia market. Not tied to one store.**

**About us**
------------

Torpedo Hospitality owns and operates 18 Jersey Mike's Subs restaurants across Georgia, from Marietta and Suwanee to Gainesville, Dahlonega, McDonough and Griffin. Every one of our shops is part of its neighbourhood: we feed the offices, schools, teams, car lots and stores down the road. We're looking for someone to make sure every one of those neighbours knows we can feed their people.

**Job summary**
---------------

We're looking for an energetic, outgoing and results-driven Local Store Marketing Coordinator to grow sales at our 18 stores by building relationships in the communities around them. The role is about revenue: catering orders, repeat business accounts and local visibility that turns into sales you can see on a ticket.

This job suits someone who loves meeting people and knows every visit, call and follow-up has one goal: bring new business into our shops and turn it into regular customers.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Business development and community sales outreach**

* Visit businesses, offices, schools, medical practices, car dealerships, big box stores, distribution centres and community organisations near our stores, with the goal of winning catering orders and repeat accounts.
* Find and get to know the people who order food: office managers, HR teams, store and sales managers, event coordinators, coaches and school administrators.
* Present our catering menu (Subs by the Box, boxed lunches, trays and platters) and our ordering options, including ezCater and online ordering, in a way that ends in an order, an account or a booked follow-up.
* Build and work a pipeline of prospects for each store, from first contact to completed order.

### **Catering and revenue growth**

* Generate new catering and large-order leads and turn them into recurring business.
* Promote staff lunches, employee appreciation meals, team and field-trip lunches, holiday and seasonal crew meals (such as Black Friday), training days and large event orders.
* Follow up consistently with prospects, past catering customers and lapsed accounts to win repeat orders and long-term relationships.
* Work with each store's General Manager so the store is ready to deliver large orders on time and to standard.

### **Local store marketing (sales-focused)**

* Hand out catering menus, flyers and offers as part of a targeted plan for each store, not general canvassing.
* Run sampling, tastings and drop-offs designed to open an account or drive an immediate order.
* Support local promotions and community events that bring measurable traffic and sales into the stores.
* Keep local listings and partner programs current where they bring in orders (for example, community and employer discount programs).

### **Catering partnerships**

* Build trackable catering partnerships with schools, booster clubs, sports teams, churches, nonprofits and employers: game-day and team meals, staff and teacher appreciation lunches, event catering and standing orders.
* Every partnership should be measurable in the point-of-sale system, with orders that can be traced to the account that placed them.
* Work with store leadership to schedule and deliver partnership orders and events that add revenue.

### **Pipeline management and reporting**

* Keep our outreach tracker up to date with every visit, contact, lead, account and order.
* Maintain an organised contact list of local businesses and community partners by store.
* Prepare weekly call and visit lists with store GMs, and report progress, wins, challenges and next steps to management every week.

**Qualifications and skills**
-----------------------------

* Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
* Comfortable with proactive outreach, walk-ins, cold calls and face-to-face selling.
* Self-motivated, organised and goal-oriented, with a clear focus on results.
* Able to plan your own week across several stores and put revenue-producing work first.
* Professional appearance and a friendly, positive attitude that fits a neighbourhood sub shop.
* Comfortable with email, spreadsheets and a phone; CRM experience is a plus.
* Reliable transportation, a valid driver's licence and willingness to drive between stores across metro Atlanta and north Georgia.

**Preferred experience**
------------------------

* Experience in sales, marketing, business development or customer service.
* Restaurant, catering, retail or hospitality experience is a plus.
* Experience working with local businesses, schools, sports programs or community organisations is a plus.

**How success is measured**
---------------------------

* New catering and business accounts opened each month.
* Catering and large-order sales growth, by store and across the group.
* Repeat orders from new and returning accounts.
* Qualified visits, calls and follow-ups completed each week.
* Catering partnerships secured and delivered.

**Compensation and perks**
--------------------------

* Hourly pay plus a performance bonus or commission tied to new accounts and catering sales.
* Mileage reimbursement for travel between stores and prospects.
* Free and discounted Jersey Mike's meals.

**Why join us?**
----------------

* A direct, visible impact on sales at 18 stores.
* Work out in the community, building real business relationships.
* A growing, locally owned team that backs your ideas.
* Earnings that grow with your results.

Our authentic taste – served Mike's Way® with lettuce, onions, tomatoes, oregano, salt, and THE JUICE (oil and vinegar) – is called our CRAVEABILITY factor. Our secret? Everything about Jersey Mike’s is the absolute highest quality, including our employees. Our USDA Prime Roast Beef is trimmed and cooked right here in the store. Our meats and cheeses are all top-quality premium brands

jobs.title: Advertising Account Manager
jobs.description:
Advertising Sales Representative Analyst | Early Career | Full time

Job No. R00374926 | Atlanta, GA

  

We are seeking an experienced Advertising Account Manager to manage and grow a portfolio of SMB advertisers on an emerging advertising platform for a global AI company.

You will combine consultative selling with hands-on campaign expertise, helping advertisers develop their strategy, launch effective campaigns, understand performance, and scale their investment. You will own client relationships from onboarding through ongoing account development, with responsibility for advertiser retention, revenue growth, and long-term success.

  

This role requires practical experience creating, managing, and optimizing digital advertising campaigns, ideally across paid social platforms. You should be comfortable advising multiple clients, diagnosing campaign challenges, and turning performance data into clear recommendations. As the platform develops, you will also help shape effective ways of working, capture advertiser feedback, and build approaches that support a growing advertising business.

What You Will Be Doing

Account Management & Advertiser Growth

* Own and develop a portfolio of SMB advertiser accounts, building strong relationships with decision-makers and becoming a trusted advertising advisor.
* Understand each client’s business model, audience, commercial objectives, and marketing priorities, translating these into tailored advertising strategies.
* Develop account growth plans with clear objectives, campaign priorities, testing opportunities, and next steps.
* Lead regular account reviews, explaining campaign results, highlighting opportunities, and agreeing actions to improve performance.
* Identify early signs of disengagement or churn and take proactive steps to address concerns and retain advertisers.
* Grow advertiser investment by demonstrating value, recommending relevant opportunities, and helping clients scale campaigns against their business goals.
* Manage expectations clearly, particularly as the platform’s capabilities and advertising offering evolve.

Campaign Strategy, Creative & Activation

* Consult with advertisers on campaign objectives, audience strategy, budgets, creative messaging, and measurement.
* Guide clients through onboarding, campaign setup, and launch, helping them establish a clear foundation for ongoing optimization.
* Apply experience from paid social and digital marketing to advise clients on effective ad copy, creative concepts, formats, and calls to action.
* Help advertisers develop creative testing plans and identify opportunities to refresh or improve their ads.
* Recommend structured tests that help clients learn what works and make informed decisions about future investment.
* Adapt recommendations to the capabilities available on the platform and each advertiser’s level of experience.

Campaign Diagnosis & Optimization

* Monitor campaign performance and identify issues affecting delivery, engagement, conversion, or return on investment.

* Interpret advertising metrics such as impressions, click-through rate, cost per click, conversion rate, cost per acquisition, and return on ad spend, where available.

The Customer Success – Ramp Specialist is responsible for overseeing customer adoption and helping newly implemented client programs accelerate adoption of our solutions.

Working closely with Implementation, Customer Success, and client stakeholders, this role manages the customer’s vendor onboarding process from implementation kickoff through achievement of agreed-upon ramp milestones. The specialist proactively monitors adoption, identifies barriers to adoption, and coordinates actions to increase utilization of Bill ReviewIQ's legal bill review solutions.

* Experience managing customer onboarding, adoption, or change management initiatives.
* Ability to influence customer behavior and drive accountability without direct authority.
* Excellent customer communication, organization, and follow-through skills.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate activities across multiple internal and external stakeholders.
* Experience with legal bill review, insurance claims, or legal operations preferred.
* Proficiency with Excel and reporting tools; Power BI experience a plus.

**Let's shape the art world of tomorrow together**

At Artlogic, our mission is to create a world with more art, and we're always looking for curious, driven people to help us make it happen. We may not be hiring for this role right now, but sometimes timing is everything.

If this sounds like you, apply through our Spontaneous Applications page on Greenhouse with your CV and a short note on why you'd like to join and which office you'd work from (London, New York or Atlanta). We'll keep your details in our Talent Pool and get in touch when the right role opens.

### **About Us**

Artlogic is a leading technology platform for the art world. Founded in 1989, Artlogic empowers over 6,000 galleries, dealers, and art professionals worldwide to streamline their operations and grow their businesses. The company's integrated platform combines inventory management, CRM, websites, sales, marketing, and payment tools, everything needed to run a modern and successful art business.

In 2021, Artlogic was acquired by tech investors Cove Hill Partners to accelerate innovation and expand its global reach. Since then, the company has doubled in size, with employees across London, New York, Atlanta, and Cape Town.

Today, Artlogic is entering an exciting new chapter through its merger with ArtCloud, another industry leader in art technology. Together, the two companies are uniting complementary platforms to build the most comprehensive, forward-thinking solution for the art world. This collaboration brings together deep expertise across CRM, sales, marketing, inventory, payments, and AI-powered tools, empowering galleries, artists, and collectors worldwide.

Joining Artlogic means becoming part of a growing global team that is shaping the future of how art is bought, sold, and managed, both online and in person.

Sales is a core function within Artlogic's Go-To-Market engine, responsible for driving revenue growth across SMB, Commercial, and Enterprise segments. The team operates within a defined sales methodology and playbook, with increasing focus on execution excellence, pipeline discipline, and consistent performance across regions.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a driven, commercially minded Sales Development Representative to join our growing Sales Team at Artlogic.

This is a proactive, target-driven role focused on generating new business opportunities across art businesses in our global markets. You will research prospective customers, drive outbound outreach, lead initial discovery conversations, and qualify opportunities for our Account Executives.

You'll engage with gallery owners, dealers, and art professionals, building relationships and helping them understand how Artlogic can streamline their operations, improve efficiency, and support their business growth.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced SaaS sales environment, enjoys proactively starting conversations and uncovering customer needs, and is motivated by achieving commercial targets while developing their consultative sales skills.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Research and identify high-potential galleries, collectors, dealers, and art businesses across our global markets to build targeted prospect lists and uncover new business opportunities.
* Proactively execute outbound campaigns through personalised emails, phone calls and targeted sales sequences to generate interest and build a qualified sales pipeline.
* Build relationships with gallery owners, dealers and key decision-makers, understanding their challenges and identifying opportunities where Artlogic can add value.
* Lead initial discovery conversations to understand customer needs, assess suitability and qualify prospects for further engagement with an Account Executive.
* Nurture prospective customers through relevant, multi-touch outreach and structured follow-up, maintaining engagement until they are ready to progress.
* Use AI as a core part of how you research and personalise outreach, and work with sales leadership to develop the AI tools and processes our team sells with.
* Book qualified meetings and product demonstrations for Account Executives, often through a live transfer on the call, providing clear discovery notes and prospect context to support an effective handover.
* Use HubSpot CRM and sales engagement tools to manage prospecting activity, maintain accurate records and track lead progression, then review your outreach and results with your manager in regular one-to-ones to see what's working and where to grow.
* Work closely with Account Executives to align outreach priorities, review lead quality and improve conversion from initial engagement to qualified opportunity.
* Monitor and report on outreach activity, response rates, meetings booked and opportunities generated, using insights to improve performance.
* Consistently achieve and exceed agreed activity, qualified meetings, and pipeline generation targets.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of prospecting approaches, outreach messaging, and sales playbooks to support Artlogic's growth.

**About you**

* 1+ years of experience in sales, ideally within B2B SaaS or Art, with a track record of achieving or exceeding targets.
* Experience in outbound prospecting or sales development within a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
* Strong prospecting and pipeline generation skills, with the confidence to proactively identify opportunities and engage new customers by phone and email.
* A consultative sales approach, with the ability to ask insightful questions, uncover customer needs, and position solutions effectively.
* Ability to build credibility quickl

jobs.description:
**Based in metro Atlanta. Field-based: you drive between our 18 stores across the Atlanta and north Georgia market. Not tied to one store.**

**About us**
------------

Torpedo Hospitality owns and operates 18 Jersey Mike's Subs restaurants across Georgia, from Marietta and Suwanee to Gainesville, Dahlonega, McDonough and Griffin. A small office team keeps the stores supplied, maintained, inspected and paid on time so the General Managers can focus on their guests.

**Job summary**
---------------

The Operations Coordinator is the office team's person in the field. You'll follow up on store requests, meet vendors and repair techs, check that work was actually done before invoices are paid, keep permits and records current, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks between the stores and the office. It's a hands-on, organised role for someone who likes solving problems in person.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Store support and follow-up**

* Visit stores on a planned weekly route and follow up on open requests, repairs and issues with each General Manager.
* Log and track store requests and maintenance tickets from report to completion.
* Follow up on items flagged in our daily and weekly controls reports (deposits, paid-out forms, temperature logs, opening checklists) and confirm they are fixed.

### **Vendors, maintenance and inspections**

* Meet repair technicians, linen, pest control and other service vendors on site, and confirm the work was completed before the invoice is approved.
* Help stores prepare for health inspections and brand standards visits, and confirm corrective actions are closed.
* Check deliveries, shortages and credits with stores and suppliers, and record what is still owed.

### **Records, permits and admin**

* Keep permits, licences, certificates and store records current and filed, and flag anything coming up for renewal.
* Collect receipts, forms and photos from stores and upload them to the right systems.
* Help with small office tasks: data uploads, simple reconciliations, spreadsheets and vendor follow-up emails.

**Qualifications and skills**
-----------------------------

* 1 to 2 years of experience in operations, administration, facilities, restaurant or retail management, or a similar role.
* Highly organised and reliable: you finish what you start and keep a clear record of it.
* Comfortable with Excel, email and Microsoft 365; quick to learn new apps.
* Clear, friendly communicator with store teams, vendors and the office.
* Reliable transportation, a valid driver's licence and willingness to drive between stores across metro Atlanta and north Georgia most days.

**Preferred experience**
------------------------

* Restaurant or multi-unit retail experience.
* Experience coordinating vendors, maintenance or inspections.

**Schedule**
------------

* Full time, Monday to Friday, daytime hours, with occasional early or late visits.

**Compensation and perks**
--------------------------

* Competitive pay, discussed at interview.
* Mileage reimbursement for travel between stores.
* Paid training and free and discounted Jersey Mike's meals.

**Why join us?**
----------------

* See the whole business, not just one store.
* A growing, locally owned team where good organisation is noticed.
* Room to grow into a larger operations role.

Our authentic taste – served Mike's Way® with lettuce, onions, tomatoes, oregano, salt, and THE JUICE (oil and vinegar) – is called our CRAVEABILITY factor. Our secret? Everything about Jersey Mike’s is the absolute highest quality, including our employees. Our USDA Prime Roast Beef is trimmed and cooked right here in the store. Our meats and cheeses are all top-quality premium brands sliced freshly before your eyes. Our bread is fresh-baked each day on premises. And of course, everything’s created right in front of you. It’s what makes Jersey Mike’s the most authentic tasting submarine sandwich available, truly a \Sub Above\, and it’s a tradition of quality we’ll never outgrow. Our team is just that as well...an amazing group of people working together, having fun, engaging with our customers and making each visit memorable with our unique, friendly, and welcoming personalities.

jobs.description:
**About Us**  
  
Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.  
  
We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.  
  
Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.  
  
At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.  
  
Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

**THE ROLE**

The **Events CSM** owns a book of ~20-30 accounts which are a mix of existing Events customers and Travel (non-Events) customers. These accounts represent the largest potential Events budget at Perk. CSM is accountable for identifying, growing and retaining the events business within these accounts. The role is split roughly 50/50:

* Business Development (50%): own your accounts long-term - you're not just reacting to requests, you're anticipating what your customers need. You proactively identify and validate each account's total Events budget (EBUM), get ahead of upcoming events before they're raised with you, and help customers get more value and repeat use out of Perk Events over time. Build lasting relationships with Customer Events POCs, and win the event requests (SQLs) that come from that budget.
* Event Operations (50%): support your customers more complex requests (booking and post-booking). Oversee automated execution for smaller events. CSM stays close to all events for their Accounts - capturing feedback to improve delivery next time, and spotting the next opportunity. Negotiate with suppliers to ensure discounts or concessions that help convert the deal and provide enhanced value to your customer.

CSMs are regionally aligned, partnering closely with the local Account Management team, since most Events accounts start as Travel accounts.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

Account ownership

* Own a book of ~20-30 accounts, a mix of existing Events customers and Travel customers with Events potential
* Understand and validate the EBUM for every account in your book
* Pick up new accounts from Events SSDRs when attractive EBUM (+100k GMV) is identified, and validate it - work to capture the SQLs that flow from the validated EBUM

Relationships

* Identify Events POC(s) at each account - multi threading is crucial
* Build strong working relationships and understand their needs
* Attend QBRs with AMs - own the Events update - sharing Events data and opportunities
* Work closely with the aligned AM on shared accounts
* Deliver regular training with customer - ensure they have the right information to enable internally

Growth (share of wallet)

* Aim to win all the SQLs (event requests) generated by your accounts' EBUM
* Identify upsell opportunities as needs evolve

Retention and loyalty

* Drive repeat bookings from your accounts
* Build the ongoing relationship that keeps customers coming back for future events
* Win the trust needed to see/convert larger deals from customers - increase average deal size

Event operations

* Support customers through the booking process and post-booking
* Capture feedback from events to understand where you can improve delivery and spot the next SQL opportunity

KPIs

* Realized revenue
* Repeat and loyalty rate
* Share of wallet
* Negotiation

**WHAT YOU BRING**

3-5+ years in corporate events, hospitality, or event planning

Experience in commercial roles - customer success management or account management is a plus

Comfortable owning a portfolio of accounts and prioritizing across them

Track record of delivering revenue and outreach results

Strong relationship-building and communication skills

Comfortable executing large or complex events flawlessly

Readiness to adopt new processes, tools and technology quickly

**WHAT MAKES YOU SUCCESSFUL HERE**

Relationship-focused - you think at the account level, not just the booking level

You are commercial - you spot growth opportunities and act on them

You are proactive - you anticipate needs before they become issues, you are excited about managing a dedicated portfolio of clients

You enjoy negotiation - you are confident and ready to push suppliers for more value, on every deal

You are an owner - your events are executed flawlessly, building trust with your accounts

You collaborate with AMs and Events Senior SDRs as part of one regional team

You're comfortable holding both relationship and operational responsibilities

**WHY PERK EVENTS?**

Own a portfolio of strategic accounts end to end

Play a critical role in scaling Perk Events by bringing on new Events customers and growing the share of wallet (EBUM)

Work alongside AMs and SSDRs as part of a connected regional team

**Our benefits:**

* Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk
* Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays
* Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex
* Plan for your future with our qualifyi

new_jobs.title: Production Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Tennis Channel is seeking a Production Coordinator to support the planning and execution of live remote events and studio shows, both domestic and international. As a key member of the Production Management team, this role works closely with the Production Manager and leads our team of Production Assistants across more than 320 live days of tennis each year. We're looking for a highly organized, proactive, and quick-thinking professional with strong communication and interpersonal skills who represents Tennis Channel professionally with crews, vendors, and partners. This role is onsite and located in Santa Monica, CA.

**In this role, you will do the following:**

* Serve as a key point of contact for production teams on remote productions, working with crews, vendors, venues, and internal departments.
* Coordinate on-location logistics from start to finish, including crew movements, equipment shipments, and vendor communication.
* Partner with the crewing team to source and hire control rooms, stage, and remote crews.
* Research and book locations, manage permitting, and process related paperwork, including vendor documents, releases, certificates of insurance, and payments.
* Partner with the Travel team to book flights, hotels, and rental vehicles.
* Ensure crew onboarding is complete before filming and support crews on location.
* Support the Production Manager in coordinating studio staff, facilities, and daily operations.
* Supervise, schedule, and support our team of Production Assistants.
* Collaborate with production teams to ensure assigned productions meet the network's creative and technical objectives.
* Help train new Production Assistants on department processes and procedures.
* Create, maintain, and quality-check production books, call sheets, daily schedules, shoot schedules, and planning documents.
* Manage daily production communications, including shoot emails and schedule updates.
* Partner with the Production Accountant and other departments to communicate budget considerations and crew assignments, create purchase orders, and ensure timely processing of crew paperwork.
* Help manage inventory, organize supplies, and coordinate shipping.

**Qualifications:**

* 3â€“5 years of experience as a production coordinator or production assistant in sports or entertainment production.
* Proven ability to multitask, adapt to a fast-paced environment, and manage several productions and deadlines at once.
* Ability to adapt and thrive in constantly changing environments with unpredictable challenges and a wide range of personalities.
* Experience leading or mentoring production assistants.
* Enthusiasm for hands-on work and the resourcefulness to roll up your sleeves and make things happen.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Experience with Smartsheet and with crewing and scheduling software preferred.
* Familiarity with location permitting, certificates of insurance, and purchase orders preferred.
* Bachelor's degree preferred.
* Flexible schedule that includes some nights, weekends, and holidays as production needs require. The tennis season runs January through November, with the heaviest workload from May through September.
* Occasional domestic and international travel.
* Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. and move large equipment cases.

Tennis Channel is proud to be equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

**About Tennis Channel**

Tennis Channel is the only multiplatform destination dedicated solely to tennis year-round. Together, the Tennis Channel flagship network, Tennis Channel 2, and the Tennis Channel app (tennischannel.com) deliver the most accessible and concentrated single-sport coverage anywhere. As the exclusive U.S. home of the ATP Tour and WTA Tour, Tennis Channel features live coverage of every Masters 1000 tournament â€” including Indian Wells, the Miami Open, Madrid, Rome, Cincinnati, and more â€” alongside live studio programming including its premier series, TC Live. Tennis Channel 2, a free FAST channel available in over 100 million homes, brings fans matches from across the globe at every level of the game. The Tennis Channel app brings it all together in one place, delivering live and on-demand matches, original content, and a personalized multi-view experience for fans, available on mobile and connected TV devices. Owned by Sinclair, Tennis Channel is also a co-owner of PickleballTV (pickleballtv.com), a joint venture with the Professional Pickleball Association.

**About Sinclair**

Sinclair, Inc. (Nasdaq: SBGI) is a diversified media company and a leading provider of local news and sports. The Company owns, operates and/or provides services to 177 television stations in 79 markets affiliated with all major broadcast networks; owns Tennis Channel, the premium destination for tennis enthusiasts; and multicast networks CHARGE, Comet, ROAR and The Nest. Sinclair's AMP Media produces a growing portfolio of digital content and original podcasts. Additional information about Sinclair can be found at www.sbgi.net.

The life-blood of our organization is our people. We have a compelling story, a goal-oriented culture, and we take really good care of people. How good? Here is a glimpse: great benefits, open-door policy, upward mobility and a strong desire to see you succeed. Ready to be part of a winning team? Let's talk.

new_jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Facilities Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Reporting directly to the GM & VP, Events & Facilities, the Executive Assistant and Facilities Coordinator provides executive support and organization to the GM and VP, Events and Facilities. This person organizes and coordinates executive outreach and internal and external relations efforts; and oversees unique assignments.

This person must be organized, creative, and enjoy working within an entrepreneurial environment that is mission-driven, results-driven, and community-oriented. The ideal individual will have the ability to exercise good judgment in a variety of situations, with strong written and verbal communication, administrative, and organizational skills, and the ability to maintain a realistic balance among multiple and possibly changing priorities.

The Executive Assistant will have the ability to work independently on projects, from conception to completion, and must be able to work under pressure at times to handle a wide variety of activities and confidential matters with discretion.

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES:**

* This role completes a broad variety of administrative tasks for the GM & VP, Events & Facilities including, but not limited to: managing an active calendar of appointments, event production support, facilities coordination, completing expense reports, composing and preparing correspondence (occasionally confidential in nature), arranging complex and detailed travel plans, itineraries, and agendas, compiling documents for meetings, and occasionally driving and picking up guests and/or packages.

* Plans, coordinates, and ensures the GM & VP, Events & Facilities’ schedule and priorities are effectively managed and executed.

* Supports workspace management and space planning, as well as the purchasing of office equipment, office supplies and office furniture.

* Supports Asset Management of art, furniture and instrument inventory, storage, repair, maintenance, and insurance

* Manage and monitor the Facilities inbox, responding to inquiries, routing requests, and ensuring timely follow-up on facility-related matters.

* Supports miscellaneous Facilities projects and requests and researches, prioritizes, and follows up on incoming issues and concerns addressed to the GM & VP, Events & Facilities, including those of a sensitive or confidential nature. Determines appropriate course of action, referral, or response.

* Provides a bridge for smooth communication between the GM & VP, Events & Facilities office and internal departments, demonstrating leadership to maintain credibility, trust, and support with senior management staff. Ensures approvals of various documents, including contracts, are addressed in a timely manner.

* Works closely with the GM & VP, Events & Facilities to keep her well informed of upcoming commitments and responsibilities, following up appropriately. Acts as a “barometer,” having a sense for the issues taking place in the environment and keeping her apprised.

* Provides leadership in building relationships crucial to the success of the organization and manages a variety of special assignments for the GM& VP, Events & Facilities some of which may have organizational impact.

* Successfully completes critical aspects of deliverables with a hands-on approach, including drafting letters, personal correspondence, and meeting materials, and other tasks that facilitate the GM & VP, Events & Facilities ability to effectively lead.

* Prioritizes conflicting needs; handles matters expeditiously, proactively, and follows through on tasks to successful completion, often with deadline pressures.

* Maintains effective filing systems for easy retrieval of documents.

* Serves as the administrative liaison to Board Committees and maintains discretion and confidentiality in relationships with all board members and assists with committee meeting scheduling, setup, and meal planning as needed.

* Adheres to compliance with applicable rules and regulations set in bylaws regarding Board and Board Committee matters, including advance distribution of materials before meetings in electronic and paper format.

* Conducts research and edits and completes first drafts for written communications and presentations.

* Coordinates logistics for visiting guests.

* Assumes other duties as assigned.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS****:**

* Minimum three (3) years administrative assistant and/or facilities-related experience

* Bachelor’s degree preferred

* Proficient in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) and Adobe Acrobat

* Extremely strong organizational skills that reflect the ability to perform and prioritize multiple tasks seamlessly with excellent attention to detail.

* Very strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships with stakeholders, including staff, board members, vendors, external partners, and donors.

* Expert-level written and verbal communication skills; ability to take meeting minutes; and create executive-level communications in Word and PowerPoint.

* Demonstrated proactive approaches to problem-solving with strong decision-making capability.

* Emotional maturity and ability to handle ambiguity and change.

* Self-starter and highly resourceful team player, with the ability to also be extremely effective independently.

* Proven ability to handle confidential information with discretion, be adaptable to various competing demands, and demonstrate the highest level of customer/client service and response.

* Demonstrated ability to achieve high-performance goals and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

* Forward-looking thinker, who actively seeks opportunities and proposes solutions.

* Positive attitude and ability to use tact, diplomacy, and discretion in handling confidential information.

* Project coordination or project management experience a plus
