new_jobs.title: Purchasing Coordinator II
new_jobs.description:
Company Overview:

**Nikkiso Clean Energy & Industrial Gases** is a leading provider of cryogenic pumps, fueling stations, heat exchangers, process systems, turboexpanders, services, and solutions for the liquefied natural gas (LNG), liquefied hydrogen (LH2), and industrial gases industries. We are a subsidiary of Nikkiso Company Ltd, a leading industrial manufacturer headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, with $1.5 B USD in annual revenue, 8000 + employees worldwide, and publicly traded on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

Job Overview:

The Purchasing Coordinator plays a vital role in supporting Nikkiso’s procurement operations by ensuring the timely and cost-effective acquisition of materials and services. This position serves as a key link between suppliers and internal departments, helping to maintain supply continuity, optimize inventory levels, and uphold quality standards. The role contributes directly to the efficiency and reliability of the supply chain, supporting both production and strategic initiatives at the Santa Ana site.

Responsibilities:

* Coordinate daily purchasing activities for raw materials, components, and services.
* Maintain accurate purchase orders and ensure timely delivery of goods.
* Liaise with suppliers to confirm availability, lead times, and pricing.
* Collaborate with internal departments (production, quality, logistics) to align purchasing with operational needs.
* Supports procurement with all accounting and receiving issues to ensure smooth & timely payment to all suppliers
* Monitor inventory levels and initiate replenishment orders as needed.
* Resolve delivery issues, discrepancies, and quality concerns with suppliers.
* Maintain procurement records and documentation in ERP systems.
* Support audits and compliance with procurement policies and procedures.
* Supports procurement with new supplier on boarding process to ensure company policy is met.

Qualifications:

* Completed commercial or technical training, ideally with a focus on procurement or supply chain.
* 2+ years of experience in purchasing or supply chain coordination, preferably in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
* Familiarity with ERP systems (Microsoft Dynamics).
* Strong communication and negotiation skills.
* Fluent in German and English (written and spoken).
* Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook).
* Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.

**Knowledge and Critical Skills/Expertise:**

* Must possess exceptional communication and presentation skills
* Exceptional attention to detail
* Competence in general computer skills and the use of common business software, to include: Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Access, etc.)
* Data management skills
* Customer relations management
* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders
* Negotiation skills

**Work Environment and Physical Demands:**

In order to perform the duties of this job, the employee may be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects, tools or controls.

Overtime may be necessary as the workload dictates. This may include weekdays, weekends, nights and/or holidays.

Ability to lift up to 25 lbs. may be required.

Job will generally be performed in an office environment, but may require travel to a Client's office, production facility or industrial/construction job site. Conditions will vary at each location, but the conditions listed above will generally apply.

**Environmental Safety Requirements**

* New Employee Safety Training is required by all newly hired employees, including Safety Awareness
* All safety related training is provided and tracked by the EHS Technician
* Job specific training modules deemed necessary by employee’s direct supervisor will be required of all employees on an ongoing basis

Employees are required to wear Nikkiso provided PPE as/when needed. PPE’s include, safety shoes, safety glasses, face shields, FR clothing, cryogenic gloves, cryogenic apron, cut resistant gloves, safety gloves, hearing protection, hard hats & dust masks. Failure to comply with Nikkiso Cryo safety requirements will result in disciplinary actions, up to and including termination.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, the employer will provide reasonable accommodations to meet the work environmental and physical demands listed above.

The knowledge, skills and abilities listed above are typically acquired through the levels of education and experience listed. An equivalent combination of education and/or experience that provides an applicant with the listed knowledge, skills and abilities required to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the job, may be accepted.

Pay Rate: $20.00 - $26.62 per hour

EEOC Statement:

**Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled**

Nikkiso CE&IG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

new_jobs.description:
**Who are Coolr?**

We’re an independent social media agency and team of creatives, social experts, content publishers and change makers. Completely wired into popular culture, our work connects brands with their audiences at scale. With clients such as Burger King, Lidl, Harvest Snaps and Skyscanner (to name drop a few) our aim is to be the biggest social agency in the world.

The agency is growing at a rapid rate, but we’re only just getting started. In 2026, we have ambitious plans to truly become the stand-out social agency in the UK, the US, and beyond. We have a strong platform for growth and have made great strides forward – now we really want to take things to the next level.

**About the role:**

We're looking for an Account Manager to join our team. You'll sit between the Senior Account Director and the Social executive below you. Owning the day-to-day running of your accounts, keeping campaigns on track and making sure the team has what they need to deliver.

This is a role for someone organized, culturally switched on and genuinely passionate about social media. You'll be hands-on across client communications, creative, production and influencer work streams.

**The job:**

**Client Services**

* Serve as the main day-to-day contact for clients, building strong working relationships under the guidance of the Account Director
* Lead scheduled and ad hoc client calls and deliver presentations with a passion for storytelling
* Keep status documents updated daily and ensure the wider team is informed of actions and priorities
* Manage campaigns end-to-end - timelines, budgets, client expectations and internal resource
* Support the Account Director on budget development and reconciliation at project close
* Support executives with weekly, monthly and quarterly reportingCreative, Strategy & Production
* Stay immersed in social culture and proactively flag reactive opportunities across your accounts
* Receive and translate client briefs, breaking these down for internal teams and reviewing work before client delivery
* Contribute to internal creative brainstorm sessions, supporting the Senior Account Director in pushing creative thinking
* Manage the full production process - from pre-production and PPMs through to shoots and edit schedules
* Manage the editorial process, briefing the team on content calendar creation and providing feedback throughout
* Review reactive social opportunities and provide appropriate creative feedback

**Influencer**

* Support the influencer team with talent management and fee negotiation
* Approve influencers and influencer content from a client and brand perspective, considering reputation, fit and objectives
* Review contracts and briefs for all influencer activity across your accounts

**Internal & Management**

* First line of support for executives - 1:1s, day-to-day guidance, workload management and mentorship
* Lead internal status calls and act as the main point of contact for internal queries on your accounts
* Manage invoicing across campaigns, including raising POs and scheduling payments with the accounts team

**What we are looking for**

*Whilst we appreciate, you’re not just your CV and skills are transferable, these are some of the skills and experiences we think would set you up for success in this role:*

* Proven experience in an account management role within a social or creative agency
* Strong client-facing skills - confident presenting, leading calls and building relationships
* Excellent project management ability - detail-oriented, deadline-driven and able to juggle multiple accounts
* Comfortable managing budgets and tracking delivery against scope
* Deeply plugged into social culture, trends and platforms
* A natural collaborator who can brief, manage and support internal teams
* Experience managing or mentoring junior team member

**A Coolr Offer**

*We appreciate all the hard work that our teams deliver every day — here are some of the benefits and perks you’ll enjoy while working at Coolr:*

Competitive salary reflective of your experience and aligned with our internal salary bands.

‍️Flexible Hybrid working. We work 3 days in the office and 2 from home

Enjoy 20 days of paid time off (PTO), in addition to all U.S. Federal Holidays.

Birthday Day off – an extra day to celebrate your big day

Wellbeing day off — one additional day off plus a $50 voucher to support your wellbeing.

Private Healthcare cover, Tech scheme + more

Coolr weekly socials - we get together every week to connect as a team

A competitive, benchmarked salary ranging from $85,000-100k, based on your experience and level.

**Coolr Culture:**

We are one team. Regardless of what you work on at the agency, we will help and support each other on everything. The goal is to turn our clients into rockstars by creating ground-breaking, award-winning and impactful campaigns for them. The team culture is to push out of our comfort zones to strive for excellence whilst allowing everyone to embrace their true selves and tap into their potential.

**Coolr DE&I**

Our approach to DE&I at Coolr is simple: create a safe and inclusive environment for people to be authentically themselves. By embracing this culture, it gives space to people to be more creative, innovative, and successful which will drive us in our mission of becoming the world’s best social media agency. Whilst we are proud of our current position and the work we do to support a thriving and diverse workplace, we always know we can do more to not only create change here at Coolr, but in our industry as a whole.

**Vintage Sales & Operations Coordinator**

LA Vintage | Full-time | On-site | Los Angeles, CA 90061

$22–$24/hr + monthly performance bonus

**About Us**

LA Vintage is a family-owned wholesale vintage company in Los Angeles. We sort millions of pounds of clothing, shoes, and accessories every year, and since 2008 we've supplied retail shops, designers, wholesalers, and stylists around the world straight from our own warehouse.

**The Role**

We're looking for an organized person to run day-to-day sales operations at LA Vintage. You'll pack and ship wholesale and online orders, price and list inventory, and keep the showroom clean and shoppable. You'll also watch sales trends, spot what's moving and what's stuck, and bring us ideas to sell more online. You know your vintage eras and brands, you're comfortable with spreadsheets, and you take pride in getting the details right.

**What You'll Do Daily**

* Pack and ship online orders accurately and on time

**What You'll Do Weekly**

* Report on orders completed, sales, listings added, and open orders
* Review sales data to review what's selling, what's sitting, and why
* Recommend one change to improve online sales (pricing, categories, listing timing, promotions)
* Flag aging inventory and recommend price adjustments
* Follow up with past clients to drive reorders

**How Success Is Measured**

* Order accuracy: orders ship complete, correct, and on time
* Sales: monthly online and client order sales against target

**What You Bring**

* 1+ years of experience with buying, selling, or pricing vintage clothing, with solid knowledge of eras and brands
* Builds routines and sticks to them
* Comfortable with numbers, spreadsheets, and tracking results
* Detail-oriented: you catch mistakes before clients do
* Clear, professional communication in writing and in person
* Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced warehouse
* Shopify, Excel, or Google Sheets experience is a plus

**Pay & Benefits**

* Monthly performance bonus based on order accuracy and sales (eligible after 3 months)

* Access to wholesale clothing

new_jobs.description:
**Step into the Night Shift at LAX**
------------------------------------

It’s 9:00 p.m. in Los Angeles, CA. You’ve just checked the inbound roster, aligned the cargo load plan, and radioed the ramp team. Minutes later, an unexpected hold appears—space confirmation needs to be revalidated and a cargo compartment must be cleared. You move quickly, coordinating with ground handling agents (AGI), confirming documentation, and keeping the flight on schedule. By 7:00 a.m., every shipment is accounted for, safety standards are met, and customers are updated—another smooth overnight operation.

**What You’ll Lead**
--------------------

* Coordinate end-to-end cargo operations while upholding safety and regulatory compliance.
* Plan, schedule, and track shipments; optimize routings to minimize delays.
* Partner with internal teams and external vendors to quickly resolve operational issues.
* Prepare, verify, and archive precise cargo documentation for all movements.
* Monitor inventory and support stock replenishment to meet service timelines.
* Audit processes regularly to identify improvements and boost efficiency.
* Deliver responsive customer service, addressing inquiries and concerns promptly.

**On the Ramp**
---------------

* Oversee ground handling agents (AGI), ensuring procedures are followed and status updates are timely.
* Verify strict adherence to cargo handling procedures, including space confirmation and cargo compartments clearance.
* Coordinate with agents to resolve unexpected on-site disruptions.
* Supervise aircraft loading and unloading activities for accuracy and safety.
* Monitor ramp operations to enable safe, on-time aircraft turns.

**Flight Documentation & Control**
----------------------------------

* Build cargo load plans using manual or computerized systems.
* Complete aircraft weight-and-balance documentation accurately.
* Coordinate with dispatchers and maintenance for inbound and outbound flights.
* Review all cargo paperwork for completeness and correctness.

**Communication & Support**
---------------------------

* Maintain clear communication with internal teams, vendors, and partner agencies.
* Champion operational efficiency, service quality, and cost control.
* Perform additional duties as assigned during the shift.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* High school diploma or equivalent; degree in logistics, supply chain, or related field is a plus.
* Hands-on experience in cargo operations or logistics management.
* Knowledge of shipping regulations and compliance practices.
* Exceptional organization and multitasking skills.
* Proficiency with logistics software and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Clear, effective verbal and written communication.
* Comfort working independently and within a team in a high-velocity environment.
* Availability for the overnight schedule: 9:00 p.m. – 7:00 a.m.

**Toolset & Expertise**
-----------------------

* Logistics Software
* Microsoft Office Suite
* Cargo Load Planning Systems

**Core Strengths**
------------------

* Cargo Operations
* Documentation Accuracy
* Logistics Management
* Shipping Regulations
* Operational Efficiency

**Department: FoodFarming**

**Job Type: Full-Time; Non-Exempt, Hourly**

**Union Status: This is a Union position**

**Ecology Center Background:**

The Ecology Center's mission is to inspire and build a sustainable, healthy, and just future for the East Bay, California, and beyond. Since 1970, we've transformed sustainability ideas into everyday practice, offering actionable information, reliable infrastructure, and leadership for lasting change. We operate the nation's first curbside recycling service, nationally recognized food and farming programs, and model education, engagement, and youth development activities.

**Role Overview:**

The Farmers' Market Access and Equity Program Coordinator works under the direction of the Farmers' Market AccessEquity Program Manager, in coordination with the Food and Farming Program Director, to assist with all aspects relating to the Ecology Center's work promoting healthy food access at California farmers' markets. The Farmers' Markets Access and Equity Program Coordinator works to establish, implement, promote, and incentivize Federal Assistance Benefit use at farmers' markets and other direct marketing outlets to create greater healthy food choices for low-income and underserved populations and drive additional customers/income to small and mid-sized family farmers.

The Ecology Center is actively working to create and promote an alternative food system that is based on the values of environmental protection, justice, and access to healthy, sustainably produced food for all. The Farmers' Markets AccessEquity Program (FMAE) seeks to create greater healthy food choices for low-income and underserved Californians while also supporting small and mid-sized family farms. The FMAE Program Coordinator works to establish, implement, promote, and incentivize SNAP benefit use at farmers' markets and other direct marketing outlets. The FMAE Program Coordinator performs job duties in support of the Ecology Center's work supporting healthy food access at California farmers' markets, including the Market Match Program, Farmers' Market EBT/SNAP access programming , and the FMFinder.org tool. This is a hybrid position that requires employees to work onsite at least 2 days per week. The position is covered under the Ecology Center/IWW Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA), and employees are required to maintain union membership once they complete their probation period.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Assist Program Manager in developing Program work-plan, goals, and objectives in accordance with grant objectives and the Ecology Center mission and strategic plan.
* Assist Program Manager in executing work-plan, goals, and objectives associated with the statewide Market Match Program, the Farmers' Market EBT/SNAP access programming, CA Alliance of Farmers Markets, and the Farmers' Market Finder tool.
* Provide support and technical assistance to Market Match partners, including but not limited to training on reporting and invoicing procedures and other program requirements
* Prepare contracts for distribution to sub awardees, and coordinate the contracting process, including follow-up with sub awardees to verify contract details, signatures, final review and approval of contracts.
* Coordinate monthly sub awardee invoice processing and reporting materials review, including verification of all expenses and backup documentation, and follow-up with sub awardees as needed.
* Assist in curating and updating the Program's outreach, promotional, and training tools including the production and distribution of the Program's electronic newsletter, the Market Match website, the Farmers' Market Finder website, the program's Facebook page and other social networking tools.
* Assist with facilitating bi-monthly webinars, phone calls, the annual Market Match conference, and other meetings.
* Educate, recruit, and inform farmers' market managers, associations, and partner organizations interested in CalFresh EBT access at farmers' markets and Market Match incentives, through the development and distribution of Program communications, including informational materials and e-newsletters.
* Periodically coordinate regional outreach campaign logistics including direct mailers, text message, and other forms of outreach, aimed at recruiting new customers to farmers' markets.
* Perform site-visits with Market Match partners throughout the state to ensure program and grant compliance.
* Input and maintain data in order to feed statewide databases, fundraise, and report for grants.
* Customize promotional, outreach, and educational collateral.
* Provide technical assistance to farmers' market managers and associations that wish to establish, implement, and promote their market's CalFresh EBT program. This includes, but is not limited to: assistance with FNS application, acquiring Point Of Sale (POS) equipment, EBT scrip design and ordering, planning for market staffing issues, record-keeping and vendor education.
* Conduct follow up activities to track and report progress in establishing and implementing EBT programs.
* Field initial phone calls and emails regarding Market Match, Farmers' Market EBT, Farmers' Market Finder, answer questions, and direct parties to appropriate resources or individuals.
* Meet with the Program Manager and FMAE team once per week or as needed.
* Observe safe operating practices and comply with organizational safety policies.
* Maintain familiarity with, follow, and ensure staff compliance with all Ecology Center policies and procedures in the performance of daily duties.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**About Shark Byte Systems Inc. (SBS)**

Shark Byte Systems Inc. (SBS) is an innovative computer vision and artificial intelligence company headquartered in New York City. We build robust, real-time visual intelligence systems and inference models deployed to solve complex operational challenges. Our technical culture is hands-on, high-ownership, and run strictly on Linux infrastructure.

**Role Summary**

Shark Byte Systems Inc. (SBS) is looking for an organized, technically grounded, and proactive Office & Operations Coordinator to serve as the operational backbone for both our NYC office and day-to-day technical workflows.

In this multifaceted role, you will bridge day-to-day office operations with ongoing technical execution. You will work closely with our field technicians and software engineers, managing incoming support queues, directing task assignments, monitoring project milestones, purchasing hardware and project equipment, handling location-setup billing transactions, and keeping our workplace running without friction. Because we do not run rigid sprint cycles, our work centers on continuous delivery, quick triage, and clear ticket prioritization.

The ideal candidate brings familiarity with a Linux-centric engineering workplace, communicates effortlessly across technical teams, and keeps projects moving forward in a fast-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities1. Technical Task Coordination & Support Operations**

* **Task & Queue Management:** Manage ongoing technician assignments, monitor day-to-day workload capacity, and maintain clear task status visibility using Jira.
* **Support Ticket Ownership:** Act as the first line for support ticket triage; prioritize incoming issues, direct assignments to the right technical specialists, follow up on blockers, and track issues to resolution.
* **Operational Syncs & Standups:** Organize and facilitate regular status check-ins, technician handoffs, and priority reviews via Google Meet.
* **Team Communication:** Keep operational channels clear, organized, and up to date using Slack (ticket updates, incident coordination, and field tech announcements).
* **Process Improvement:** Continuously refine ticketing pipelines, intake forms, and resolution workflows to reduce turnaround times and support our technicians effectively.

**2. Project Procurement & Location Billing Operations**

* **Project Equipment Purchasing:** Source, order, and track delivery of specialized hardware, cameras, sensors, cabling, tools, and technical gear required for client deployments and technician project rollouts.
* **Payment Gateway Management:** Administer merchant gateways/payment portals to process customer credit card charges for initial location onboarding.
* **Billing Records & Expense Tracking:** Maintain accurate purchase orders, receipts, transaction records, and invoice logs reconciled with the accounting team.

**3. Office & Workplace Administration**

* **NYC Workplace Logistics:** Manage on-site office operations, desk setups, supply inventory, shipping/receiving of gear, and overall facility readiness.
* **Vendor & Facilities Liaison:** Serve as the point of contact for NYC building management, facilities personnel, maintenance, and internet/utility service providers.
* **Onboarding & Workstation Staging:** Partner with technical leads to coordinate workstation preparation (hardware procurement, seating, access passes) and schedule first-week onboarding for new team members.
* **Company Culture & Events:** Organize team lunches, tech demonstrations, client site visits, and team social events.

**Qualifications & SkillsCore Qualifications (Must-Haves)**

* **Location:** Based in the Greater New York City area with the ability to work on-site at our NYC office.
* **Relevant Experience:** 2–5 years of experience in project management, technical operations coordination, or office administration within a tech company, IT services provider, or fast-paced startup.

* **Procurement & Financial Admin:** Experience managing purchasing/procurement pipelines for equipment and navigating credit card payment gateways/billing tools (e.g., Stripe, Authorize.net, Square, or similar merchant platforms).
* **Modern Collaboration Tools:** Proficiency with Slack (channel administration, thread organization) and Google Workspace (Google Meet, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Calendar).
* **Communication & Multi-Tasking:** Exceptional written and verbal communication; ability to balance office logistics alongside fast-moving technical ticket queues and purchasing requests.
* **Project Methodology:** Experience with continuous flow, Kanban, or ITIL-style incident and support queue management.

**Familiarity & Nice-to-Haves**

* **Linux Familiarity:** Familiarity with or comfort working in a Linux-centric environment (including basic command-line interface literacy or shell basics, such as Ubuntu or Debian), as SBS operates on Linux systems and servers.
* **Hardware & Network Familiarity:** Prior exposure to or general familiarity with network routers, switches, and cameras is a plus.

**Benefits & Perks**

* **Commuter Support:** Pre-tax commuter benefits (MTA / transit passes).
* **Time Off:** Paid time off (PTO) plus standard holidays.

new_jobs.title: Customer Marketing Associate
new_jobs.description:
Reejig is the Work Operating System for the AI powered enterprise.

We give companies a complete, validated view of their work by mapping every role, task, skill, and workflow. With this intelligence, we redesign how work should flow, surface where automation creates the highest leverage, and recommend the right AI agents for the enterprise.

Every change is measured and tied to real operational and workforce impact.

Inside Reejig, we build the same future we sell. We are developing our own AI powered workforce that supports our teams and our customers.

This is a place for builders who want to help define how work will operate in the AI era.

**The Role**

We work with some of the world's most influential leaders in AI, HR and workforce transformation.

We're looking for a Customer Marketing Associate to help our customers feel connected to Reejig — making sure their success gets celebrated, their stories get heard, and the relationship keeps growing.

You'll work closely with Marketing, Customer Success and Sales to run the campaigns and programmes that engage our customers throughout their journey with Reejig. Over time, you'll get to know our customers well — who their champions are, what they're trying to achieve, and where there's an opportunity to deepen the relationship.

And when a customer is doing something great with Reejig, you'll work with Customer Success to help find that story, capture it, and turn it into something the rest of the market can see.

This is an early career role with a lot of room to grow. We're looking for someone curious, organised and customer-obsessed who wants to learn how a customer marketing function comes together.

**What You Will Own**

**Customer Engagement**

* **Customer lifecycle campaigns.** Run thoughtful campaigns that engage customers at the moments that matter - from the moment they join Reejig through onboarding, key milestones, launches, expansions, anniversaries and renewals.
* **Customer moments.** Find ways to make our customers feel recognised and part of what we're building. Celebrate their people and the work they're pioneering.
* **Customer communications.** Make sure customers know what's happening at Reejig and have opportunities to engage with our thinking, products, events and people - without filling their inbox with generic marketing.

**Customer Intelligence**

* Work with Customer Success and Sales to understand our accounts - who's involved, what they care about, what they're trying to achieve
* Keep account maps up to date, and flag where we have gaps in relationships

**Customer Proof**

* Stay close to Customer Success to help identify outcomes, quotes and moments worth sharing
* Help turn customer conversations, results and milestones into stories, testimonials, quotes and sales evidence
* Work with Content, Social, Sales, PR and Events to help our best customer stories get seen

**Customer Advocacy**

* Help build and maintain a list of customers open to sharing their experience with Reejig
* Support opportunities for customers to have a voice — webinars, events, references, media

**What Good Looks Like at 90 Days**

* You know our customers - their priorities, champions, key stakeholders and where the strongest opportunities sit.
* Every strategic customer has a current account map showing where relationships are strong and where we need to build them.
* A clear customer marketing calendar is live across lifecycle campaigns, customer moments and communications.
* We have a visible pipeline of customer stories, proof points and advocacy opportunities.
* Our strongest customer stories are consistently being turned into proof that Marketing and Sales can use.
* Customer Success, Sales and Marketing have a simple operating rhythm for sharing customer intelligence and identifying opportunities.

**Who You Are**

* You have some experience in marketing, customer success, content, or another customer-facing role - internships count. We care more about curiosity and potential than years of experience.
* You're genuinely curious about customers - you want to understand what they're trying to achieve and what makes them excited about working with a company.
* You're a solid writer and communicator, and you're keen to get better at turning what you hear into a clear story.
* You're organised - you can keep track of details across a few accounts at once without dropping things.
* You're proactive - if you spot something worth flagging, you say something rather than waiting to be asked.
* You like working with people - customers, Customer Success, Sales - and you're comfortable asking questions to learn.
* You want to build a career in customer marketing, and you're excited to learn from a small, fast-moving team.

**Why This Matters**

Reejig is at a point of real inflection. We are building a company that will reshape how organisations operate in the AI era. The people who join now are not stepping into a role, they are stepping into a chance to build something with scale and long term impact. If you want work that changes your career and creates meaningful equity upside, this is the moment.

*The expected annual base salary for this role is $65,000–$85,000 USD, depending on experience, plus equity.*

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (Investor Experience)
new_jobs.description:
**About Frec**
--------------

Frec is building the modern investment platform for high-net-worth investors. We combine self-directed investing with continuously managed strategies in a single brokerage account, bringing capabilities traditionally delivered through wealth managers directly to our customers.

We see AI as a way to make sophisticated investing more personal and intuitive. The investment infrastructure we’ve already built gives us a foundation to help customers make better decisions without giving up control of their financial lives.

Customers have entrusted us with $1.5 billion in assets, up 4x in the last year. We’re backed by Greylock and have reached this scale with a small team. The people who join now will help build the primary investment platform for a new generation of investors.

**The role**
------------

As an early member of Frec's Investor Experience team, you'll play a critical role in building lasting customer relationships and shaping how we serve investors as we scale.

You'll own the post-onboarding customer relationship, acting as a knowledgeable and trusted point of contact for investors with increasingly sophisticated financial needs. Your goal is to ensure customers understand the value of Frec’s investment strategies, feel confident using our platform, and have an exceptional experience throughout their relationship with Frec.

This role requires investment fluency, analytical thinking, strong relationship management skills, and the ability to make complex financial concepts accessible. You'll help customers understand everything from direct indexing and tax-loss harvesting to long short strategies, portfolio leverage, financing costs, and investment performance.

Beyond working directly with customers, you'll help build the systems, processes, and standards that define how Frec delivers an exceptional investor experience at scale.

**What you'll do**

* Own the post-onboarding customer relationship, building trust and driving long-term engagement, satisfaction, and retention.
* Help investors understand their portfolios, investment strategies, performance, tax-loss harvesting, fees, and financing costs.
* Investigate complex customer issues, taking ownership from initial discovery through resolution.
* Partner with product, engineering, and brokerage operations to identify root causes, prioritize improvements, and resolve issues.
* Identify early signs of customer dissatisfaction or disengagement and develop strategies to address them.

* Own and improve key customer experience metrics, including NPS, CSAT, customer health, retention, and response times.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation, AI, and better processes.
* Collect and synthesize customer feedback to influence product development and business priorities.
* Partner with sales and marketing to create a seamless experience across the entire customer journey.

**What you bring**
------------------

* 4+ years of experience in wealth management, brokerage, fintech, customer success, or a related client-facing financial services role.
* SIE, Series 7, and either Series 65 or Series 66 credentials in good standing.
* Strong understanding of financial markets, investment products, brokerage accounts, margin, leverage, and financing costs.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build credibility with sophisticated investors.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and meticulous attention to detail.
* Experience working with CRM and customer engagement platforms, such as HubSpot.
* A proactive, ownership-oriented approach. You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, investigating problems independently, and building processes where they don't yet exist.
* A bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base salary with performance-based bonus opportunities
* Meaningful equity ownership in a fast-growing company
* Fully covered health and dental insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Monthly wellness stipend to support physical and mental health
* Flexible paid time off
* Daily in office lunch
* The opportunity to build and shape a core function at an early-stage fintech company

Startup experience as well as familiarity with direct index and tax loss harvesting concepts is a plus! If you’ve worked in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement listed.

Must be able to work on-site 4 days/week from either NYC or SF

Compensation Range: $130K - $170K

new_jobs.title: Vendor Operations Associate, Accounts Payable
new_jobs.description:
Order.co is the System of Action for the Office of the CFO, transforming the way businesses purchase and pay into an intuitive, B2C-like shopping experience. Order.co leverages embedded AI agents and embedded financial products to reinvent the way businesses connect with their vendors.

End users enjoy a seamless, zero-training buying experience, while finance and procurement leaders gain a single platform to orchestrate how the business “should operate”. The result is an all-in-one solution that serves as a gravitational pull for spend and data, automating and eliminating procurement and finance workflows from requisition to reconciliation along the way.

Order.co is on the cutting edge of B2B Agentic Commerce, poised to be the market leader in creating a more predictive, prescriptive, and personalized experience for users.

Founded in 2016 and headquartered in New York City, Order.co oversees nearly half a billion in annualized spend across hundreds of customers like WeWork, SoulCycle, Lume, and [solidcore]. Order.co has raised $75M in funding from industry-leading investors like MIT, Stage 2 Capital, Rally Ventures, 645 Ventures, and more. Order.co has been proudly named a 50 to Watch by Spend Matters and a Best Place to Work by BuiltIn and Inc. Magazine.

Order.co is looking for a Vendor Operations Associate, Accounts Payable to own our day-to-day accounts payable work: managing the AP inbox, paying vendor invoices accurately and on time by credit card and ACH, reconciling statements, and resolving payment issues quickly.

This is an early career role ideal for someone who enjoys problem solving, investigating issues, and working with people. You'll spend your day working through the AP inbox, processing invoice payments, reconciling vendor statements, and working with vendors and teammates to resolve discrepancies.

The role sits within our Vendor Operations organization and works closely with Accounts Payable, Fulfillment Operations, Customer Success, and our offshore operations team.

We're looking for someone who is curious, organized, accountable, and excited to learn. Prior experience in procurement, accounts payable, or vendor management is encourage but not required.

**What You'll Do**

Own and Monitor the Accounts Payable Function

* Manage the Accounts Payable inbox: triage incoming invoices, statements, and vendor inquiries, respond promptly, and escalate as needed.
* Pay vendor invoices by credit card and ACH, confirming amounts, payment details, and due dates before each payment goes out
* Reconcile invoices and vendor statements against orders and payment records
* Clarify irregular invoice items with vendors and internal teams and resolve discrepancies before payment
* Review vendor files, net terms, and payment history to ensure timely payments

Work Directly with Vendors

* Communicate with vendors to resolve order issues, payment issues, and fulfillment questions
* Help vendors understand and comply with Order.co purchasing and fulfillment processes
* Identify recurring vendor behaviors that create operational challenges and work toward long-term solutions
* Build productive relationships with vendor contacts while representing Order.co professionally

Drive Continuous Improvement

* Look for patterns and recurring issues across vendors, orders, and workflows
* Suggest improvements and automations that reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency
* Collaborate with offshore team members to ensure work is completed accurately and on time
* Contribute to process documentation and operational best practices

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong attention to detail and follow-through, especially with invoice data, payment amounts, and vendor details
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to stay organized while managing multiple priorities efficiently
* Comfortable solving problems independently and asking questions when needed
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn
* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, including formulas, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, and sorting and filtering large data sets
* Comfortable with email and business software

**Why This Role Matters**

Every day, thousands of orders flow through the Order.co platform. While many are automated, some require investigation, coordination, and problem solving to ensure successful completion.

This role serves as a critical bridge between customers, vendors, and internal teams, helping ensure vendors are paid accurately and on time, orders are fulfilled, vendors remain compliant with our processes, and operational issues are resolved before they impact the customer experience.

It's an opportunity to develop valuable skills in accounts payable, operations, vendor management, procurement, and process improvement while making an immediate impact on the business.

**What You'll Receive**
-----------------------

* A competitive compensation package including stock options
* Employer-sponsored 401(k) with employer match
* Robust medical, dental, vision, and wellness benefits
* Flexible time off and remote work policies
* Generous leave policies and support for new and current parents
* The anticipated hourly rate for this role is $25-$27/hour. Actual compensation and title will be commensurate with experience, qualifications, knowledge, and skills.

new_jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
new_jobs.description:
Vestwell is the financial technology company powering the new savings economy. The New York City-based fintech platform redefines how people save for the critical aspects of life across retirement, education, and healthcare savings needs. Today, Vestwell enables over 790,000 businesses and more than 2.75 million active savers, with over $57 billion in assets saved across all 50 United States.

Vestwell offers a range of products, including workplace-delivered retirement plans, employer-offered student loan repayment benefits, and various savings accounts for education, emergencies, and individuals with disabilities.

Vestwell's platform serves a diverse clientele, including financial advisers, employers, third-party administrators, financial institutions, payroll providers, government agencies, and individual savers. To learn more, visit vestwell.com

**Who Are We Looking For?**

At Vestwell, we know that the key to growth is a high-performing sales team. That's why we're seeking a qualified Sales Development Representative (SDR) to find and screen potential customers who could benefit from our range of financial wellness products and services. As the first line of communication with a prospect, the ideal SDR has a strong understanding of the sales methodology and excels at:

* Engaging new clients through high volume calls and call cadences
* Driving qualification, urgency and intent
* Creating effective sales meetings for sales closers that optimize prospect conversion

Vestwell SDRs should be a quick learner who has strong communication skills and an ability to showcase our offerings in a compelling way. SDRs are generally in this role between 6-9 months. After month 9, successful SDRs are eligible for promotion into full cycle, closing roles.

**What Will You Be Doing?**

* Represent the company's products and services & deliver Vestwell's value proposition to new prospects, including both financial advisors and business owners.
* Qualify prospects, build intent & generate new meetings for sales through outbound calling.
* Manage and maintain a pipeline of interested prospects and engage sales leaders in next steps.
* Own your personal growth and development as a Vestwell sales representative by learning the financial services industry, Vestwell's range of financial wellness solutions, and the mechanics of a modern sales process.
* Ability to utilize Salesforce & Salesloft to manage lead lists.
* Understanding the Vestwell partnerships.
* Understanding the products and services Vestwell offers.
* Master talk tracks and ability to qualify prospects.
  + Identify the needs of prospects, and suggest appropriate products or services.
* Set up meetings for prospects with field sales representatives.
* Report to sales manager with weekly, monthly, and quarterly results.

**Requirements**

The Necessities

* Strong communication skills via phone and email.
* Proven, creative problem-solving approach and strong analytical skills.
* Displays self-motivation for sales coaching and development.
* Strong desire and ability to move up within a sales organization.

The Extras

* Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) or at least five years of relevant work experience.
* Previous experience in sales, with a track record of exceeding lead targets.
* Experience as a sales development representative, with a track record of achieving & exceeding sales quotas.
* Proficiency with Salesforce, Salesloft, or other CRM software.
* Financial services &/or small business sales experience.

This role will be based in our Austin or New York office, and will be part of Vestwell's hybrid in-office operation.

The expected base salary range for this position is a minimum of $55K - $60K, plus performance based variable. Please note that salary bands are based on NY and other similar metro areas and may differ based on where the role is ultimately hired.

**Full-Time Employee Benefits**  
We're an innovative, high-growth company with an exciting future ahead. At Vestwell, we prioritize employee wellbeing through comprehensive health benefits, generous time off, and a dedicated Employee Wellbeing Committee. Our hybrid work model offers flexibility while providing access to our collaborative offices in Midtown Manhattan, Austin, King of Prussia, and Scottsdale. And, of course, as a company focused on helping people save for the future, we offer a competitive 401(k) plan.

**Interview Process**  
Our interview process starts the same for every candidate with 1-2 introductory conversations to learn more about your background, interests, and what you're looking for, while also giving you the opportunity to learn more about Vestwell and the team. From there, the process varies by role but typically includes a skills or experience-based assessment, such as a coding interview, portfolio review, or deeper discussion of your relevant experience. Successful candidates then move on to a virtual or in-person interview panel. Before extending an offer, we complete a reference check with a current or former manager and a peer. Throughout the process, we prioritize transparency, clear communication, and minimizing surprises.

  

For your awareness you will only receive correspondence from recruiting@vestwell.com any other domain not ending in vestwell.com is not our Recruitment team.

*Vestwell's* *Privacy Policy.* *Attention California residents: In the course of conducting our business and complying with federal, state, and local government regulations governing such matters as employment, tax, insurance, etc., we must collect Personal Information from you. Should you accept employment with Vestwell you may view our California Privacy Rights Act here:* *Vestwell's California Privacy Rights Policy.*

new_jobs.title: Junior Technology Sales Representative
new_jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

eMazzanti Technologies is looking for recent graduates and early-career professionals who want to build a career in technology sales.

You do not need years of IT or sales experience. We are looking for someone who communicates well, enjoys meeting new people, is curious about technology, and is motivated to learn and grow.

As an Outside Sales Consultant, you will learn how businesses use cybersecurity, Microsoft 365, cloud, AI, and managed IT services. You will also gain hands-on experience in prospecting, customer discovery, presentations, relationship building, and the sales process.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Identify and develop new business opportunities.
* Connect with prospective customers through phone, email, LinkedIn, networking, and business events.
* Build relationships with business owners and decision-makers.
* Learn about prospective customers, their goals, and their technology challenges.
* Introduce prospective customers to eMazzanti's services and technology solutions.
* Work with technical team members to understand and present cybersecurity, cloud, AI, Microsoft, and managed IT solutions.
* Schedule and participate in meetings with prospective customers.
* Develop presentation, negotiation, and sales skills.
* Maintain accurate customer activity and opportunity information in our CRM.
* Follow up consistently with prospective customers.
* Participate in sales training, coaching, and professional development.
* Work toward individual and team sales goals.

  
Requirements:
  

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Recent graduate or early-career professional.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Comfortable starting conversations and meeting new people.
* Professional and customer-focused approach.
* Interest in technology and business.
* Goal-oriented with a willingness to learn.
* Strong organization, time management, and follow-through.
* Positive attitude and openness to coaching and feedback.
* Self-motivated and able to take initiative.
* Must be located in New Jersey and able to work from our Hoboken office.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Previous internship, customer service, sales, retail, hospitality, business development, or other customer-facing experience.
* Interest in sales, business, entrepreneurship, marketing, or technology.
* Leadership experience through college organizations, athletics, volunteering, or extracurricular activities.
* Familiarity with Microsoft products, LinkedIn, CRM platforms, or prospecting tools.
* Bachelor's degree preferred.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base salary plus commission opportunities.
* Sales training and mentorship.
* Hands-on experience in B2B technology sales.
* Exposure to cybersecurity, cloud, AI, Microsoft technologies, and managed IT services.
* Ongoing professional development.
* Opportunities to take on additional responsibilities as you develop.
* Career growth opportunities within the technology industry.
* Collaborative and supportive team environment.

new_jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative - Climate Control Commercial
new_jobs.description:
**Join Our Team!**

Sunbelt Rentals strives to be the customer's first choice in the equipment rental industry. From pumps to scaffolding to general construction tools, we aim to be the only call needed to outfit a job site with the proper equipment. Not only do we offer a vast fleet that ranks among the best in the industry, we pair it all with a friendly and knowledgeable staff. Our employees are our greatest asset, and although we present a comprehensive equipment offering, our expertise and service are what truly distinguish us from the competition.

We pride ourselves on investing in our workforce and offer competitive benefits, as well as extensive on-the-job training for all eligible employees.

As a highly successful national company, we are constantly looking for talented individuals to support our growth. If you are interested in pursuing a rewarding career, we invite you to review our opportunities!

**Job Description Summary**

Outside Sales Representative – HVAC & Commercial

As an Outside Sales Representative for Sunbelt Rentals Climate Control Service, you be responsible for renting and selling our diverse line of portable air conditioners, dehumidifiers, air scrubbers and temporary heaters within assigned territory. The typical customer base constitutes a mix of commercial customers, contractors and event companies.

In addition to cultivating existing accounts and developing new ones, you will work closely with our General Tool Division and other Specialty Divisions providing turn-key solutions utilizing Sunbelt’s wide array of equipment and services. This will entail working closely with the Sale Reps and Managers throughout the organization maximizing our penetration within a new and existing customer base.

Sunbelt Rentals-the fastest growing rental business in North America-is seeking an Outside Sales Representative.

* Bachelor’s degree in a related field of study or equivalent experience in equipment rental or HVAC industry
* 2+ years of direct sales experience
* Current/valid driver’s license in good standing, and proof of auto insurance

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities you may rely on:

* Sales track record in solution-selling approach

The physical demands of this role require bending, squatting, crouching, reaching, lifting 25 pounds or more, and working indoors/outdoors when required by the job. The above description is not a complete listing of all miscellaneous, incidental or similar duties which may be required from day to day. new_jobs.description:
**About us**
------------

Ann Taylor embodies and celebrates the spirit, heritage, and confidence of American women leading the lives they love. Since its beginnings, Ann Taylor has been committed to providing women with everything they need to feel inspired and motivated as they navigate their multifaceted lives. Our effortlessly polished styles are thoughtfully designed to go anywhere—from the office to special occasions (and everywhere in between).Discover a culture centered on empowering employees, with access to industry leaders and tools you need to expand your skills and stretch your abilities. We'll meet you at every milestone with opportunities and benefits to make life better in and outside of work (not to mention your closet). Ready to join us?

**About the role**

The Coordinator, Brand Marketing will play an integral role in bringing Ann Taylor and the Ann Taylor Factory brand to life, owning day-to-day marketing operations and supporting the execution of integrated marketing initiatives across retail and customer touchpoints.

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Brand Marketing, this role will be responsible for leading the daily Ann Taylor Factory marketing strategy, supporting the daily Ann Taylor marketing strategy, and coordinating factory and full price retail marketing initiatives. The Coordinator will partner with cross-functional teams to ensure campaigns are executed seamlessly, customer-facing messaging is clear and compelling, and marketing initiatives are delivered on time and in alignment with business objectives.  
  
This is an ideal opportunity for an organized, proactive marketer who thrives in a fast-paced retail environment, takes initiative and is eager to develop a well-rounded understanding of brand marketing.

**The impact you can have**

Ann Taylor Factory

* Support the seasonal GTM strategy.
* Own the day-to-day execution and monthly planning of marketing operations for Ann Taylor Factory, ensuring initiatives are planned, communicated and executed accurately and on time.
* Manage Factory promotional marketing, partnering with cross-functional teams to develop and execute clear, compelling customer-facing sales messaging.
* Coordinate promotional updates, creative approvals and marketing deliverables, proactively flagging changes or issues that may impact execution.
* Develop a strong understanding of retail business drivers and promotional performance to help ensure marketing communications support business objectives.

Beyond Ann Taylor Factory, the person in this role will be a key full price partner supporting the Assistant Manager & Senior Manager of Brand Marketing on larger tasks that contribute to the seasonal GTM strategy. Brand Marketing Operations

* Manage asset distribution, approvals and follow-up across projects, maintaining attention to detail throughout the process.

* Identify opportunities to improve team processes, organization and efficiency.
* Maintain cutting-edge knowledge of the evolving multi-channel marketing space

**You’ll bring to the role**

  

* 1–2 years of marketing experience; retail marketing experience preferred.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
* Understanding of promotions, sales messaging and the role marketing plays in driving customer engagement and business results.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Proactive, resourceful and solutions-oriented, with a willingness to take ownership and initiative.
* Collaborative mindset and comfort working across teams and with external partners.

* You will be eligible to receive a merchandise discount at select KnitWell Group brands, subject to each brand’s discount policies.

* Support for your individual development plus opportunities for career mobility within our family of brands.

* Medical, dental, vision insurance & 401(K).\*
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
* Time off – paid time off & holidays.\*
* The target pay range for this role is: $24.04 - $26.00 per hour

* Any job offer will consider factors such your qualifications, relevant experience, and skills. Eligibility of certain benefits and associate programs are subject to employment type and role.

* **Hybrid:** This position works in a hybrid model, with three days per week worked in the Times Square Tower corporate office location in New York, NY and two days per week worked remotely.

new_jobs.title: Executive Assistant, AI & Merchandising
new_jobs.description:
**Executive Assistant to the Owner, AI & Merchandising**

**\*\*\*Onsite work is required four days a week.\*\*\***

We are looking for an Executive Assistant with a strong, working understanding of AI to serve as the Owner's right hand and trusted lieutenant. The Owner leads merchandising, design, sourcing, production, and sales. This role keeps the business running smoothly around him and joins him in every business meeting.

This is not a traditional calendar-and-inbox role. The Owner is highly knowledgeable about AI and uses it daily on his phone, but does not work on a computer, email or desktop software such as Windows and Excel. The Executive Assistant will be his partner in bringing AI tools and processes into the company: turning his ideas into working computer-based workflows, handling the desktop and email side of the business, and helping the team adopt AI.

The ideal candidate also brings a flair for marketing and merchandising: an eye for product, trends and brand presentation, and a genuine interest in what makes customers buy.

**Key Responsibilities**

***AI Enablement (Top Priority)***

* Use AI tools daily to draft correspondence, summarize documents, prepare meeting notes, research vendors and markets, and organize information for the Owner.
* Work closely with the Owner on his AI vision, translating ideas he develops on his phone into tools, documents, and workflows the team uses on their computers.
* Identify everyday tasks across merchandising, design, sourcing, production, and sales where AI can save time or improve results.
* Help pilot, document and roll out new AI tools and workflows with department teams, including simple how-to guides and training.
* Follow company guidelines on confidentiality and data privacy when using AI tools and flag risks to the Owner.
* Stay current on new AI tools.

***Marketing and Merchandising Support***

* Support the Owner on merchandising decisions, including line reviews, assortment planning, pricing discussions, and sell-through tracking.
* Prepare polished product presentations, line sheets and showroom materials for buyers and customers.
* Help create marketing content such as product descriptions, social media posts, email campaigns, and sales presentations, using AI tools to draft and refine them.
* Research trends, competitors, and customer preferences, and share insights that inform design and product decisions.
* Use AI to analyze sales data and identify best sellers, slow movers, and new opportunities.
* Coordinate with design, production and sales teams on product launches, samples, and market events.

***Executive and Administrative Support***

* Manage the Owner's email, calendar, travel, and correspondence on his behalf, since he does not use email or a computer, and function as his first point of contact.
* Prepare reports, spreadsheets, presentations and briefing materials, turning information from different departments into clear summaries he can review easily on his phone.
* Handle confidential business information with discretion.

***Meetings***

* Attend all business meetings with the Owner, including internal, vendor, factory, and customer meetings.
* Prepare agendas and background materials, take notes, and distribute summaries and action items.
* Follow up on commitments made in meetings and keep the Owner informed of progress.

***Project Coordination***

* Track many projects at once across merchandising, design, sourcing, production, and sales, and keep them moving.
* Prioritize tasks based on urgency and the Owner's goals and escalate issues before they become problems.
* Serve as a liaison between the Owner and department heads, vendors, and customers.

**Qualifications**

Required: A Strong Understanding of AI

This is the most important qualification for the role. The Owner understands AI well and is looking for someone who does too: a person who knows how AI tools work, what they do well, where they fall short, and how to apply them to genuine business problems. Basic familiarity with a chatbot is not enough.

* Solid understanding of how AI tools work, including their strengths, their limits, and common errors such as confident but incorrect answers.
* Hands-on, regular use of AI assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot or Gemini for real work, not just casual experimentation.
* Ability to write clear prompts and judge AI output, checking it for accuracy before relying on it.
* Experience using AI to draft, summarize, research, analyze data or automate routine tasks.
* Awareness of the current AI landscape, including new tools and how businesses are putting them to use.
* Ability to keep up with an AI-savvy Owner, discuss AI tools and ideas at his level, and turn them into practical processes for the business.
* Understanding of the basics of responsible AI use, including protecting confidential and personal information.

**Required: Experience and Skills**

* Proven ability to manage many projects at once and prioritize under pressure.
* Personable, warm, and professional, able to build relationships with team members, vendors, and customers.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Advanced skills in Microsoft 365 (Excel, Outlook, Word, PowerPoint) or Google Workspace, since this role handles all computer-based work for the Owner.
* High discretion with confidential business information.
* Self-starter who anticipates needs and works independently while the Owner travels.

***Preferred***

* Experience in a product-based business such as home furnishings, fashion, consumer goods, or design.
* Experience in merchandising, marketing, or product development, with a strong eye for product, trends, and brand presentation.
* Experience with social media, e-commerce, or digital marketing, including AI tools for content creation and imagery.
* Experience helping a team adopt innovative technology or processes.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

new_jobs.description:
Explore a World of Opportunity with the State of Georgia!

We are the force that drives Georgia!
  
Georgia State Government is a large enterprise, composed of various agencies and entities with a common goal to improve the lives of Georgia's more than 10 million citizens!
  
Join Team Georgia and impact lives everyday while receiving a robust benefits package designed for every stage of your career!

**Job Title:**

Career Advisement Program Specialist

**Agency:**

Department of Education

**Job Requisition ID:**

JR0000008552

**Shift:**

Day (United States of America)

**Compensation Details:**

COMMENSURATE WITH EXPERIENCE

**Job Description:**

The Georgia Department of Education (GaDOE) – Career, Technical, and Agricultural Education (CTAE) Division is seeking a Career Advisement Program Specialist to provide statewide leadership, coordination, and strategic oversight for Georgia’s K–12 Career Advisement Program. Under limited supervision, this position will support the development, implementation, continuous improvement, and evaluation of career advisement initiatives aligned with state priorities and workforce development goals. The Career Advisement Program Specialist will develop resources and guidance, coordinate professional learning, provide technical assistance to schools and districts, monitor program effectiveness, and collaborate with internal and external partners to strengthen career pathways and improve student career readiness.

  
  

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Develop and communicate career advisement guidance, instructional resources, and implementation supports.
* Plan, coordinate, and deliver statewide career advisement professional learning and provide technical assistance to schools and districts for K–12 educators.
* Provide training on Georgia’s interest and aptitude assessment to support local education agencies (LEAs) in effectively utilizing the assessment.
* Identify and vet credentialing and micro-credentialing programs for career advisors.
* Collaborate with the Georgia Professional Standards Commission to develop certification options for career advisors.
* Develop and maintain external partnerships with school systems, postsecondary institutions, business and industry partners, and other education stakeholders.
* Collaborate with GaDOE Program Specialists for Work-Based Learning, Economic Development, and Dual Enrollment to align activities and opportunities and support data collection and analysis.
* Create and support a statewide cohort or association for school- and district-based career advisors to provide networking opportunities, strengthen professional collaboration, and establish best practices.
* Build relationships and collaborate with postsecondary partners to support alignment of career advisement processes and outcomes.
* Maintain current knowledge of career advisement research and evidence-based instructional practices and develop and maintain related resources.
* Use program and student outcome data to inform continuous improvement.
* Monitor program implementation and effectiveness using relevant data.
Represent GaDOE in state, regional, and national career advisement initiatives to share Georgia’s work, identify emerging practices, and support the continued improvement of career advisement throughout the state.  

Please note that statewide travel is required.

  
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

Preference will be given to applicants who, in addition to meeting the minimum qualifications, possess one or more of the following:

* Master’s degree or higher in School Counseling, Educational Leadership, CTAE, Workforce Development, Higher Education Administration, or a related field.
* Hold or be eligible for a Georgia Professional Standards Commission educator certificate.
* Knowledge of career development theory and best practices, K–12 career advisement frameworks, career pathways and programs of study, postsecondary education and workforce opportunities, work-based learning models, industry-recognized credentials, labor market information, federal and state education initiatives affecting career readiness, and data collection, reporting, and program evaluation.
* Experience working with multiple stakeholder groups, including educators, administrators, postsecondary institutions, employers, workforce agencies, and community organizations.
* Experience using student career planning systems and/or career information systems.
* Experience implementing a comprehensive K–12 career advisement model.
* Experience aligning career advisement with graduation requirements and Individual College & Career Plans (ICCPs).
* Experience developing and facilitating professional learning for K–12 educators and instructional leaders.
* Experience developing career advisement instructional resources, implementation guidance, or technical assistance for K–12 educators.
* Experience using student achievement, program implementation, or other educational data to support continuous improvement.
* Experience analyzing and interpreting data.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Strong technology skills, including proficiency with Microsoft 365 and digital instructional and collaboration tools.
* Familiarity with current career advisement research, evidence-based instructional practices, and workforce trends.
* Experience using labor market information to inform career pathways and advisement practices.
* Experience developing guidance documents, toolkits, and implementation resources.

High school diploma/GED and seven (7) years of program management experience; or two (2) years of experience required at the lower level Education Prgm Spec 3 (EDP032) or position equivalent.

new_jobs.title: Local Store Marketing Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Based in metro Atlanta. Field-based: you drive between our stores and prospects across the Atlanta and north Georgia market. Not tied to one store.**

**About us**
------------

Torpedo Hospitality owns and operates 18 Jersey Mike's Subs restaurants across Georgia, from Marietta and Suwanee to Gainesville, Dahlonega, McDonough and Griffin. Every one of our shops is part of its neighbourhood: we feed the offices, schools, teams, car lots and stores down the road. We're looking for someone to make sure every one of those neighbours knows we can feed their people.

**Job summary**
---------------

We're looking for an energetic, outgoing and results-driven Local Store Marketing Coordinator to grow sales at our 18 stores by building relationships in the communities around them. The role is about revenue: catering orders, repeat business accounts and local visibility that turns into sales you can see on a ticket.

This job suits someone who loves meeting people and knows every visit, call and follow-up has one goal: bring new business into our shops and turn it into regular customers.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Business development and community sales outreach**

* Visit businesses, offices, schools, medical practices, car dealerships, big box stores, distribution centres and community organisations near our stores, with the goal of winning catering orders and repeat accounts.
* Find and get to know the people who order food: office managers, HR teams, store and sales managers, event coordinators, coaches and school administrators.
* Present our catering menu (Subs by the Box, boxed lunches, trays and platters) and our ordering options, including ezCater and online ordering, in a way that ends in an order, an account or a booked follow-up.
* Build and work a pipeline of prospects for each store, from first contact to completed order.

### **Catering and revenue growth**

* Generate new catering and large-order leads and turn them into recurring business.
* Promote staff lunches, employee appreciation meals, team and field-trip lunches, holiday and seasonal crew meals (such as Black Friday), training days and large event orders.
* Follow up consistently with prospects, past catering customers and lapsed accounts to win repeat orders and long-term relationships.
* Work with each store's General Manager so the store is ready to deliver large orders on time and to standard.

### **Local store marketing (sales-focused)**

* Hand out catering menus, flyers and offers as part of a targeted plan for each store, not general canvassing.
* Run sampling, tastings and drop-offs designed to open an account or drive an immediate order.
* Support local promotions and community events that bring measurable traffic and sales into the stores.
* Keep local listings and partner programs current where they bring in orders (for example, community and employer discount programs).

### **Catering partnerships**

* Build trackable catering partnerships with schools, booster clubs, sports teams, churches, nonprofits and employers: game-day and team meals, staff and teacher appreciation lunches, event catering and standing orders.
* Every partnership should be measurable in the point-of-sale system, with orders that can be traced to the account that placed them.
* Work with store leadership to schedule and deliver partnership orders and events that add revenue.

### **Pipeline management and reporting**

* Keep our outreach tracker up to date with every visit, contact, lead, account and order.
* Maintain an organised contact list of local businesses and community partners by store.
* Prepare weekly call and visit lists with store GMs, and report progress, wins, challenges and next steps to management every week.

**Qualifications and skills**
-----------------------------

* Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
* Comfortable with proactive outreach, walk-ins, cold calls and face-to-face selling.
* Self-motivated, organised and goal-oriented, with a clear focus on results.
* Able to plan your own week across several stores and put revenue-producing work first.
* Professional appearance and a friendly, positive attitude that fits a neighbourhood sub shop.
* Comfortable with email, spreadsheets and a phone; CRM experience is a plus.
* Reliable transportation, a valid driver's licence and willingness to drive between stores across metro Atlanta and north Georgia.

**Preferred experience**
------------------------

* Experience in sales, marketing, business development or customer service.
* Restaurant, catering, retail or hospitality experience is a plus.
* Experience working with local businesses, schools, sports programs or community organisations is a plus.

**How success is measured**
---------------------------

* New catering and business accounts opened each month.
* Catering and large-order sales growth, by store and across the group.
* Repeat orders from new and returning accounts.
* Qualified visits, calls and follow-ups completed each week.
* Catering partnerships secured and delivered.

**Compensation and perks**
--------------------------

* Hourly pay plus a performance bonus or commission tied to new accounts and catering sales.
* Mileage reimbursement for travel between stores and prospects.
* Free and discounted Jersey Mike's meals.

**Why join us?**
----------------

* A direct, visible impact on sales at 18 stores.
* Work out in the community, building real business relationships.
* A growing, locally owned team that backs your ideas.
* Earnings that grow with your results.

Our authentic taste – served Mike's Way® with lettuce, onions, tomatoes, oregano, salt, and THE JUICE (oil and vinegar) – is called our CRAVEABILITY factor. Our secret? Everything about Jersey Mike’s is the absolute highest quality, including our employees. Our USDA Prime Roast Beef is trimmed and cooked right here in the store. Our meats and cheeses are all top-quality premium brands
